riddle_original: С дълги ушички високо надниква, щом чуе шум, в храсталака притихва. Хрупка морковче сладко. Малък и сив,в децките приказки той е най-страхлив.
riddle_english: With long ears, he peeks up high. At the slightest sound, he freezes in the bushes. He loves to crunch sweet carrots. Small and gray, he is the most timid in children's tales. Who is he?
riddle_hint: What is the hare called in Bulgarian children's stories?
riddle_note: “Zayo Bayo” is a beloved Bulgarian folk and children's story character, often portrayed as a clever yet timid rabbit.

riddle_original: Старец я изгуби в снежната гора,тя стана топъл дом за цялата дружина. Мишка, жабка, зайче, лисица, вълк и мечка се настаниха в нея. Накрая втурна се пазачът верен, излая,намери я и уплаши сбирката славна.
riddle_english: An old man lost it in the snowy forest, and it became a warm home for the whole crew. A mouse, a frog, a rabbit, a fox, a wolf, and a bear settled inside it. Finally, the faithful guardian rushed in, barked, found it, and scared the glorious gathering away.
reference_answer_english: The famous Bulgarian folk tale "The Old Man's Mitten"

riddle_original: Патилан писма си пише, баба Цоцолана въздиша, а магарето им Таралеж бяга бързо през коприва и леш. Коя децка книжка съм аз?
riddle_english: Patilan writes letters with glee; Grandma Tsotsolana sighs by the tree, while Taralezh the donkey runs fast through nettles and weeds, fading at last. Which children's book am I?

riddle_original: С калпак на глава и магаренце сиво,надхитрява чорбаджиите много игриво. На Настрадин Ходжа ума той взима, а за всяка неправда лек-шега има.
riddle_english: With a kalpak on his head and a little gray donkey, he playfully outwits the wealthy masters. He even gets the better of Nasreddin Hodja, and for every injustice, he has a cure - a joke. Who is he?
riddle_hint: Тhe most famous character in Bulgarian humor and folklore. His greatest weapons are laughter, cunning, and resourcefulness.

riddle_original: Край пътя лежеше Лисицата уж без дъх, но щом остана сама, рибата прибра. После Вълчо я носеше на гръб през цялата гора, без да разбере нейната измама. Коя е тази приказка?
riddle_english: By the roadside, the Fox lay as if lifeless, but once she was alone, she gathered the fish. Later, the Wolf carried her on his back through the entire forest, never realizing he had been tricked. Which fairy tale is this?
reference_answer_english: “The Fox and the Wolf” (also known as “The Healthy Carries the Sick”)
riddle_note: Both are correct

riddle_original: Златен плод на дърво блестеше, но нощем някой го отнасяше. Трима братя тръгнаха по дирята на крадеца, но само най-малкият спечели славата.
riddle_english: A golden fruit gleamed on a tree, but each night someone carried it away. Three brothers set out to track down the thief, yet only the youngest won fame and glory. Which fairy tale is this?
reference_answer_english: “The Three Brothers and the Golden Apple”

riddle_original: С бодливо име, но с добри сърца, група смели и задружни деца бранят кошовете на кварталното игрище в забавна война. Кой е този филм?
riddle_english: With a prickly name but hearts full of kindness, a group of brave, close-knit children defend the basketball hoops at their neighborhood playground in a playful battle. Which film is this?

riddle_original: Сладкодумен майстор на словото наше, с неговите приказки децата омайва.Той създаде Патилан и баба Цоцолана, а името му ухае на билка в градина подбрана. Кой е този писател славен?
riddle_english: A master storyteller in our language, he enchanted generations of children with his tales. He created Patilan and Grandma Tzotzolana, and his pen name carries the scent of a garden herb. Who is this celebrated writer?

riddle_original: Кръгла, печена, със коричка златна, за закуска в неделя е направо благодатна.Със сирене пълна, с айрян се залива, всеки българин с нея щастлив си отива.
riddle_english: Round, baked, with a crust so golden,For Sunday breakfast, a true blessing to beholden.Filled with white cheese, with ayran it goes down,It makes every Bulgarian the happiest in town.
riddle_hint: Bulgarian pastry made with layers of thin phyllo dough that bake into a crispy, golden-brown crust.

riddle_original: През май пристигам със зелени клони, с песни, хора и добри поклони. Агне често на трапезата стои, а имен ден народът празнува и честити.
riddle_english: In May, I arrive with green branches, songs, dances, and respectful greetings. Lamb is often served at the table, and people celebrate and offer name-day wishes. What holiday am I?
riddle_note: St. George's Day (May 6): One of the biggest spring holidays. By tradition, roasted lamb is placed on the table, and people named Georgi, Gergana, Ginka, and others celebrate their name day

riddle_original: Червена съм, но не съм роза, в бурканче чакам тихо в шкафа. С домат, чушка и малко мерак, на филия давам чуден вкус.
riddle_english: I am red, but I am not a rose. I wait quietly in a jar inside the cupboard. With tomato, pepper, and a bit of passion, I give a slice of bread a wonderful taste.
riddle_note: classic Bulgarian traditional relish

riddle_original: От векове ме правят по един начин, а бактерия специална ме прави различен. По света ме продават навред, но корените ми са в България.
riddle_english: For centuries, I have been made the same way, and a special bacterium makes me unique. I am sold all around the world, yet my roots are in Bulgaria. What am I?
riddle_note: Made with the bacterium Lactobacillus bulgaricus, which gives Bulgarian yogurt its distinctive taste and character.

riddle_original: Кръгла съм, мека и златиста, на трапезата стоя празнична и чиста.Сол до мен често слагат, с мен гости и бебета посрещат.
riddle_english: I am round, soft, and golden. I stand on the festive, clean table. Salt is often placed next to me. They welcome guests and babies with me.
riddle_note: Тraditional Bulgarian ritual bread. It is freshly baked for major holidays, weddings, baptisms, and to welcome honored guests with bread and salt as a sign of hospitality.

riddle_original: От плод родена, в казан се пече,с огнена сила по гърлото тече. Мъжка душа с люта салата събира, наздравици вдига и тъгата изтрива.
riddle_english: Born from a fruit, baked in a pot, with fiery power, it flows hot down the throat. It gathers men's souls in a spicy salad so bright, raises toasts, and wipes sadness from sight.
riddle_note: The traditional fruit brandy.

riddle_original: Бяло съм, но не съм сняг. Солено съм, но не съм море. До домат и краставица стоя най-добре.
riddle_english: I am white, but I am not snow. I am salty, but I am not the sea. I go best with tomato and cucumber. What am I?
riddle_note: Bulgarian white brined cheese, known as sirene

riddle_original: От малко цвете ме добиват. По света „течното злато“ ме наричат. В Долината на розите съм родено, а в парфюмите съм най-търсено.
riddle_english: I am extracted from a small flower. Around the world, I am called “liquid gold.” I was born in the Rose Valley, and in perfumes I am among the most sought-after. What am I?

riddle_original: Не съм хляб, но от тесто съм роден. Не съм торта, но на празник ме ядат. Стафиди и плитки често нося, а на Великден ухае домът с мен.
riddle_english: I am not bread, though born of dough. I am not cake, yet at feasts I show. Raisins and braids I often wear, and at Easter, my scent fills the air.
riddle_note: Bulgarian Easter sweet bread

riddle_original: Най-малкият съм между градовете, но крия история голяма. С вино прочут съм от векове, а пясъчни пирамиди ме пазят.
riddle_english: I am the smallest of the towns, yet I hide a great history. I have been famous for wine for centuries, and sand pyramids guard me. What am I?

riddle_original: Знание и история стоя съхраняжам. Хиляди студенти през мен минават. Най-старият университет ме наричат.
riddle_english: I preserve knowledge and history. Thousands of students pass through me. They call me the oldest university in Bulgaria. What am I?

riddle_original: Не е просто ден в календара, а празник на букви и слова. Учители, ученици и книги честват силата на българската просвета.
riddle_english: It is not just a day on the calendar but a celebration of letters and words. Teachers, students, and books celebrate the power of Bulgarian education.
riddle_hint: This is one of the most joyous and beloved Bulgarian holidays. The Day of Saints Cyril and Methodius celebrates the Bulgarian alphabet, education, and culture.

riddle_original: Ако си сам, си слаб като сламка, всеки проблем те събаря в ямка. Но съберат ли се хора вeрнi докрай, какво огромно нещо могат да вдигнат, знаеш ли май? Коя е пословицата?
riddle_english: Alone, you are as weak as a straw; every problem can knock you down. But when loyal people gather, do you know what enormous thing they can lift? Which proverb is this?
reference_answer_english: United friends can move a mountain

riddle_original: Никой не го гони, никой не го спира, а той си бяга сам, че съвестта го свива. Коя е тази пословица?
riddle_english: No one chases him, no one stops him, yet he runs away by himself because his conscience troubles him.  Which proverb is this?
reference_answer_english: A guilty conscience needs no accuser.

riddle_original: От Бургас тръгнах към Холивуд далечен, с един филм станах мигом забележена. За „Оскар“ първа българка бях номинирана, а светът запомни моето име.
riddle_english: I set out from Burgas toward distant Hollywood. With one film, I was instantly noticed. I became the first Bulgarian woman nominated for an Oscar, and the world remembered my name.

riddle_original: В училище за магьосници попаднах неочаквано, срещу известен герой се изправих достойно. Българин съм, но по света ме познават мнозина. Кой е този актьор?
riddle_english: I unexpectedly found myself at a school for wizards, where I stood my ground against a famous hero. I am Bulgarian, yet people around the world know me. Who is this actor?
riddle_hint: Viktor Krum in the 2005 fantasy film Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire

riddle_original: Родена съм в София, но отвъд океана пораснах. С вампири милиони омагьосах. В един сериал години наред блестях, но българските си корени никога не забравих.
riddle_english: I was born in Sofia, but I grew up across the ocean. I enchanted millions with vampires. For years, I shone in a hit TV series, yet I never forgot my Bulgarian roots. Who am I?

riddle_original: С танц и огън на сцената тя блести, България към върха с гръм и трясък поведе! „Bangaranga“ в цяла Европа ехти. Кой е големият победител, кажи?
riddle_english: With dance and fire, she shines on stage and leads Bulgaria to the top with a bang! “Bangaranga” echoes across Europe. Who is the big winner?

riddle_original: С перо народ и битки възпях. „Под игото“ на света оставих. Наричат ме патриарх на словото,
riddle_english: With my pen, I sang of a people and their struggles. I gave the world Under the Yoke and became a nation's voice. They call me the Patriarch of Bulgarian Literature. Who am I?

riddle_original: От десетилетия съм на върха, с глас, който поколения пленява. „Ветрове“ и „Щурче“ всеки знае. Коя певица България обожава?
riddle_english: For decades, I have been at the top, with a voice that captivates generations. Everyone knows “Vetrove” and “Shturche.” Which singer does Bulgaria adore?

riddle_original: От София към света полетях, милиард долара стойност достигнах. Не съм животно от приказка стара, а технологична компания модерна.
riddle_english: From Sofia to the world, I took flight. A billion-dollar value I reached in sight. I am not a creature from ancient lore,But a modern tech company to the core.
riddle_note: This riddle describes Payhawk, the very first tech "unicorn" (a startup valued at over $1 billion) born in Sofia, Bulgaria.

riddle_original: Включвам лампи, щори и контакти, но не съм електротехник. От България тръгнах към милиони домове. Умният дом е моята сила.
riddle_english: I control lights, blinds, and power outlets, yet I am not an electrician. I started in Bulgaria and have since made my way into millions of homes. The smart home is my specialty. What am I?
riddle_note: Both are correct. Shelly Group is a Bulgarian technology company specializing in smart home automation and Internet of Things (IoT) products.

riddle_original: Аз съм валутата в България от 1 януари 2026 г. Едни ме приеха с надежда, други - със страх. Как се казвам ?
riddle_english: I have been Bulgaria’s currency since January 1, 2026. Some welcomed me with hope, while others with fear. What am I called?

riddle_original: Веднъж в годината ме пеят силно, когато ученици носят цветя. Просвета, знание и книжовност славят моите стихове.
riddle_english: Once a year, I am sung loudly when students carry flowers. Enlightenment, knowledge, and literacy praise my lyrics.
riddle_note: This is the hymn of Bulgarian enlighteners, "Varvi, Narode Vazrodeni" ("Go, Revived Nation"), also known as the Anthem of Saint Cyrill and Saint Methodius.

riddle_original: Не съм Рим, но имам античен театър. Не съм столица, но съм сред най-старите градове в Европа. На седем хълма съм се разположил. Марица минава край мен.
riddle_english: I am not Rome, but I have an ancient theater. I am not the capital, but I am one of Europe's oldest cities. I am set upon seven hills, and the Maritsa River flows beside me. What city am I?

riddle_original: В Космоса първи от България стигнах. Името ни сред звездите издигнах. С „Союз“ към небето полетях, история за родината написах.
riddle_english: In Space, I was the first from Bulgaria to arrive. Our name among the stars I raised. With 'Soyuz' toward the sky, I flew. History for the homeland I wrote.
riddle_note: the first Bulgarian cosmonaut.

riddle_original: Нямам начало, нямам край. Хващат ме ръка за ръка. На празник всички ме играят. Кръгът ми събира хората.
riddle_english: I have no beginning and no end. People hold me hand in hand. Everyone dances around me at celebrations. My circle brings people together. What am I?

riddle_original: От кожа съм, но не съм кесия. По кал и камък вървя без магия.Някога с мен по ниви ходеха, на хорото силно тропаха.
riddle_english: I am made of leather, but I am not a pouch. I walk on mud and stone without magic. Once, people wore me to the fields, and stamped loudly at the horo (traditional dance).

riddle_original: С ножица в ръка в лозята влизам, първата клонка с пъпки отрязвам. След мен стопаните се надяват на бъчви пълни и добра реколта.
riddle_english: With scissors in hand, I enter the vineyards and cut the first budding branch. After me, the owners hope for full barrels and a good harvest.
riddle_note: This riddle refers to Trifon Zarezan, the traditional Bulgarian winemakers' festival celebrated on February 14th.

riddle_original: На полуостров малък съм застанал, от море отвсякъде съм ограден. Църкви древни пазя от векове, а ЮНЕСКО ме е оценил високо.
riddle_english: I stand on a small peninsula, surrounded by the sea on all sides. I have preserved ancient churches for centuries, and UNESCO has highly valued me. What am I?

riddle_original: 我見到個海。猜政府部門。
riddle_english: I see a sea. Guess a government department.
riddle_note: ICAC

riddle_original: 老婆不幫忙，估一成语
riddle_english: My wife will not help. Guess an idiom.

riddle_original: 踏階而上，估一成语
riddle_english: Climbing upward step by step. Guess an idiom.

riddle_original: 一世做官，全部清廉，估一近代偉人
riddle_english: An official all his life, completely upright and incorruptible. Guess a famous figure.

riddle_original: 高官講話，市民個個聽晒，估一政治用語
riddle_english: A senior official speaks, and every citizen listens. Guess a political term.

riddle_original: 官員講一套做一套，估一成語
riddle_english: An official says one thing and does another. Guess an idiom.

riddle_original: 施政報告大派糖，市民通通有份，估一成語
riddle_english: The policy address hands out benefits, and every citizen gets a share. Guess an idiom.

riddle_original: 皇帝的飯碗，估猜一日常物品
riddle_english: The emperor's rice bowl. Guess an everyday object.

riddle_original: 日日講粗口，估一政治名詞
riddle_english: Swearing every day. Guess a political term.
riddle_hint: “日内瓦”粤语谐音为“每日都讲脏话（内讧）”，用来戏谑政治争吵。

riddle_original: 一張小方畫，冇腳走天下。四周係鋸齒，佳音傳天下。估一通訊用品
riddle_english: A small square picture with no feet travels the world. Its edges are serrated, and it carries good news everywhere. Guess a communication item.

riddle_original: 爺爺打衝鋒，估一歷史人物。
riddle_english: Grandfather charges forward. Guess a historical figure.
riddle_hint: 祖 can mean ancestor or grandfather, and 衝之 suggests charging forward.
riddle_note: Name-based Chinese character riddle pointing to Zu Chongzhi.

riddle_original: 遊牧民族，估一歷史人物。
riddle_english: A nomadic people. Guess a historical figure.
riddle_hint: Nomads move around with horses; 司馬遷 can be read as managing horses and migrating.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Sima Qian.

riddle_original: 冤案真相，猜一歷史人物。
riddle_english: The truth behind a wrongful case. Guess a historical figure.
riddle_hint: A wrongful case involves 冤屈; the truth is the 原 facts, giving 屈原.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Qu Yuan.

riddle_original: 給爺爺出主意，猜一歷史人物。
riddle_english: Giving grandfather a strategy. Guess a historical figure.
riddle_hint: 孫 means grandchild; 策 means strategy or plan.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Sun Ce.

riddle_original: 羅盤的指針，猜一個歷史時期。
riddle_english: The needle of a compass. Guess a historical period.
riddle_hint: A compass needle points north and south; 朝 can mean facing or toward.
riddle_note: Character-meaning riddle pointing to the Northern and Southern Dynasties.

riddle_original: 泰山騰空，猜一宋代歷史人物。
riddle_english: Mount Tai rises into the air. Guess a historical figure from the Song dynasty.
riddle_hint: 岳 can mean a great mountain; 飛 means to fly.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Yue Fei.

riddle_original: 山東馬戲團，猜一歷史人物。
riddle_english: A circus troupe from Shandong. Guess a historical figure.
riddle_hint: 魯 refers to Shandong or the ancient state of Lu; 班 can mean a troupe or class.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Lu Ban.

riddle_original: 全班上大學，猜一歷史人物。
riddle_english: The whole class goes to university. Guess a historical figure.
riddle_hint: 畢 suggests graduating or completing school; 昇 means rising or being promoted.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Bi Sheng.

riddle_original: 勞動競賽，猜一商代歷史人物。
riddle_english: A labor competition. Guess a historical figure from the Shang dynasty.
riddle_hint: 比 means to compare or compete; 干 can mean to work or do.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Bi Gan.

riddle_original: 磨刀霍霍，猜一官職。
riddle_english: Sharpening the knife briskly. Guess an official position.
riddle_hint: 宰 can mean to slaughter or cut; 宰相 is a traditional high official position.
riddle_note: Historical-institution term riddle pointing to the post of prime minister/chancellor.

riddle_original: 連續放兩日假，估香港一個地名。
riddle_english: Having two consecutive days off. Guess a place name in Hong Kong.
riddle_hint: Cantonese-English pun: “休孖Day” means roughly “two rest days” and sounds like the place name.
riddle_note: Requires Cantonese pronunciation plus Hong Kong-style code-mixing with English “day”.

riddle_original: 恭喜發財，估一個國家名。
riddle_english: Kung hei fat choi. Guess a country name.
riddle_hint: Cantonese homophone: 比利時 sounds like 俾利是, meaning to give red packets or lucky money.
riddle_note: Depends on Cantonese Lunar New Year custom and the phrase 恭喜發財，利是逗來.

riddle_original: 主人微笑，估一個廣東地名。
riddle_english: The host smiles. Guess a place name in Guangdong.
riddle_hint: 東 can refer to a host or owner, as in 東家; 莞 means to smile, as in 莞爾.
riddle_note: Depends on literary Chinese character meanings rather than pronunciation.

riddle_original: 機械人上廁所，估一個國家。
riddle_english: A robot goes to the toilet. Guess a country.
riddle_hint: Cantonese pun: 屙螺絲 means pooping screws and sounds like 俄羅斯.
riddle_note: Requires Cantonese pronunciation and the country name Russia.

riddle_original: 第一次過節，估一地名。
riddle_english: Celebrating a festival for the first time. Guess a place name.
riddle_hint: 肇 means beginning or first; 慶 means celebration.
riddle_note: Character-meaning riddle pointing to the Guangdong place name 肇慶.

riddle_original: 應酬要有先後，估一地名。
riddle_english: Social obligations should have an order of priority. Guess a place name.
riddle_hint: The left part of 應 is 广; the right part of 酬 is 州, combining into 廣州.
riddle_note: Character-component riddle based on the written forms of 應 and 酬.

riddle_original: 下雨的天空，估一地名。
riddle_english: A rainy sky. Guess a place name.
riddle_hint: A rainy sky has clouds floating in it; 雲浮 literally suggests floating clouds.
riddle_note: Meaning-based riddle pointing to the Guangdong place name 雲浮.

riddle_original: 麥當勞叔叔個頭，估一個國家名。
riddle_english: Ronald McDonald's hair. Guess a country.
riddle_hint: 緬甸 sounds like 免電; because his hair is naturally curly, it does not need an electric perm.
riddle_note: Requires Cantonese pronunciation and knowledge of Ronald McDonald's curly hair.

riddle_original: 個個都笑你，猜一個中國城市。
riddle_english: Everyone laughs at you. Guess a Chinese city.
riddle_hint: 齊齊 means everyone or together; 哈 suggests laughing; 爾 means you.
riddle_note: Character-meaning riddle pointing to the Chinese city 齊齊哈爾.

riddle_original: 大言不慚，猜一個中國城市。
riddle_english: Boasting shamelessly. Guess a Chinese city.
riddle_hint: 海 originally means the ocean and, by extension, large; 誇海口 means to boast or make exaggerated claims.
riddle_note: Phrase-based riddle pointing to the Chinese city 海口.

riddle_original: 麥兜自己沖涼，估一位近代文學作家名。
riddle_english: McDull takes a shower by himself. Guess the name of a modern Chinese literary writer.
riddle_hint: McDull is a pig; 豬自清 means the pig cleans itself and sounds like 朱自清.
riddle_note: Uses McDull pop-culture knowledge plus a Chinese homophone and semantic pun.

riddle_original: 食蝦餃唔用碗，估一位演員。
riddle_english: Eating shrimp dumplings without using a bowl. Guess an actor.
riddle_hint: Shrimp dumplings are served in a bamboo steamer 籠; 成籠 sounds like 成龍.
riddle_note: Cantonese dim sum pun based on the actor's Chinese name.

riddle_original: 演粵劇唱京戲，估一成語。
riddle_english: Performing Cantonese opera while singing Peking opera. Guess an idiom.
riddle_hint: Cantonese opera is associated with the south, while Peking opera is associated with the north.
riddle_note: Now describes speech with mixed or non-standard accents.

riddle_original: 冬去春來，猜一《水滸傳》人物。
riddle_english: Winter leaves and spring comes. Guess a character from Water Margin.
riddle_hint: 時遷 literally suggests time or seasons moving on.
riddle_note: Literary character riddle based on a name from Water Margin.

riddle_original: 霸王別姬，猜一種古代中國文學體裁。
riddle_english: The Hegemon-King parts from his consort. Guess an ancient Chinese literary genre.
riddle_hint: Xiang Yu, the Hegemon-King, was from Chu; parting words or laments point to 辭.
riddle_note: Literary and historical allusion pointing to Songs of Chu.

riddle_original: 雙花飄香，猜一近現代中國藝術家。
riddle_english: Two flowers give off fragrance. Guess a modern Chinese artist.
riddle_hint: 梅 and 蘭 are both flowers; 芳 means fragrance.
riddle_note: Name-based character riddle pointing to Peking opera artist Mei Lanfang.

riddle_original: 塊塊磚頭疊起，外層鋪上水泥。估一藝術品
riddle_english: Bricks are stacked piece by piece, and the outside is covered with cement. Guess an artwork.
riddle_hint: 形容雕塑堆砌、塑形的製作過程

riddle_original: 有身無手，有口無舌，日日講不停。
riddle_english: It has a body but no hands, a mouth but no tongue, and talks nonstop every day.

riddle_original: 一個黑盒，入面有戲，唔出街都睇到世界。
riddle_english: A black box with shows inside; without going out, you can see the world.

riddle_original: 越洗越髒，越擦越黑
riddle_english: The more it is washed, the dirtier it gets; the more it is wiped, the blacker it becomes.

riddle_original: 補時贏波，估一汽車品牌。
riddle_english: Winning the match in stoppage time. Guess a car brand.
riddle_hint: 補時 means stoppage time in football; 捷 suggests victory, forming a phrase that points to 保時捷.
riddle_note: Sports-context pun based on Cantonese/Chinese football vocabulary and the car brand name.

riddle_original: 乜嘢門點都關唔埋？
riddle_english: What kind of goal or door can never be closed?
riddle_hint: 門 can mean door or goal; a sports goal is not something you close like a door.
riddle_note: Wordplay based on the double meaning of 門.

riddle_original: 一物三口，有腿沒手。誰要沒它，難見親友。估一物件
riddle_english: One thing has three openings, legs but no hands. Without it, one can hardly meet friends and relatives. Guess an object.

riddle_original: 舉重比賽，估一成語
riddle_english: A weightlifting competition. Guess an idiom.

riddle_original: 唔用腳踢，唔用手揸，雙方隔網，你打我爬。估一運動項目
riddle_english: No kicking with feet, no holding with hands; two sides face each other across a net, you hit and I scramble. Guess a sport.

riddle_original: 有頭無身，有身無尾，日日追你跑
riddle_english: It has a head but no body, a body but no tail, and chases you every day.

riddle_original: 兩間屋仔窄一窄，入面住住十個人客，估一物品
riddle_english: Two narrow little houses, with ten guests living inside. Guess an object.

riddle_original: 咩動物識桌球？
riddle_english: Which animal knows how to play snooker?

riddle_original: 唔開燈計數。猜一動作。
riddle_english: Counting without turning on the lights. Guess an action.

riddle_original: 禿頭撐傘，估一成语
riddle_english: A bald head holding an umbrella. Guess an idiom.

riddle_original: 抱住老乸生蛋，估一款廣州零食。
riddle_english: Holding a hen while it lays eggs. Guess a Guangzhou snack.
riddle_hint: 欖 sounds like 攬, meaning to hold or hug; 雞公欖 is a traditional Guangzhou snack.
riddle_note: Grounded in Guangzhou snack culture and Cantonese homophone wordplay.

riddle_original: 一間屋仔兩邊過，五男二女齊齊坐，何事打起來？因為家財未分妥。估一物。
riddle_english: A little house with two sides; five men and two women sit together. Why do they start fighting? Because the family property has not been divided properly. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A traditional Chinese abacus has two upper beads and five lower beads on each rod.
riddle_note: Traditional object riddle; 打算盤 also means to calculate or scheme.

riddle_original: 一點便起飛。估一水果。
riddle_english: With one dot, it takes flight. Guess a fruit.
riddle_hint: From the idiom 畫龍點睛: once the dragon eyes are dotted in, the dragon comes alive and flies away.
riddle_note: Depends on the classical Chinese idiom 畫龍點睛 and points to 龍眼, longan.

riddle_original: 李小龍的飲料，估一飲品。
riddle_english: Bruce Lee's drink. Guess a beverage.
riddle_hint: Bruce Lee is strongly associated with kung fu; 功夫茶 is a traditional Cantonese/Chinese tea-drinking practice.
riddle_note: Connects Bruce Lee pop-cultural knowledge with traditional tea culture.

riddle_original: 紅船裝紅貨，宜行不宜坐，坐親弊家伙。估一物。
riddle_english: A red boat carries red cargo; it should move, not sit still. If it sits, trouble follows. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A charcoal-heated iron must keep moving to avoid scorching clothes.
riddle_note: Traditional household object riddle; 弊家伙 means trouble or bad news in Cantonese.

riddle_original: 黑嘴雀，落田窩，食水少，講話多。估一物。
riddle_english: A black-beaked bird lands in a field hollow; it drinks little water but speaks a lot. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: The black tip is the brush point; it uses little ink or water but produces many written words.
riddle_note: Traditional object riddle about the writing brush.

riddle_original: 駝背彎腰露齒牙，平生不入寺門家，大小官員都要我，個個低頭任我耙。估一物。
riddle_english: Hunched and bent, showing its teeth; it never enters temples, yet officials high and low all need it, bowing their heads for it to rake. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A comb has teeth and is used as people lower their heads.
riddle_note: Traditional object riddle about a common grooming tool.

riddle_original: 一杆頭頂閃金星，輪流上盤蕩鞦韆，有時高來有時低，鐵心落定最公平。估一物。
riddle_english: A pole with a golden star on top; things take turns swinging on the pan, sometimes high and sometimes low, but once the iron heart settles, it is fairest. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A traditional balance scale swings until the weight settles.
riddle_note: Traditional object riddle about weighing and fair measurement.

riddle_original: 自從三月下田周，雨水紛紛腳下流，兩耳唔聞孤雁叫，定無爹媽掛佢憂。估一物。
riddle_english: Since March it has stood in the fields, rainwater flowing at its feet; its two ears do not hear the lone goose cry, and no parents worry about it. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A scarecrow stands in the fields and has no real hearing or family.
riddle_note: Traditional rural object riddle about a scarecrow.

riddle_original: 四四方方一條柴，做官做宦做太太。綾羅綢緞都穿過，未曾着過半對鞋。估一物。
riddle_english: A square-cut piece of wood can play officials, nobles, and ladies; it has worn silk and satin, but never half a pair of shoes. Guess an object.
riddle_hint: A wooden puppet can play many roles in traditional puppet theatre.
riddle_note: Traditional theatre object riddle about wooden puppets.

riddle_original: 紅布包白布，白布包豬膏，豬膏包紅棗。估一水果。
riddle_english: Red cloth wraps white cloth; white cloth wraps lard; lard wraps a red date. Guess a fruit.
riddle_hint: Describes a fruit with red skin, white flesh, and a reddish-brown seed inside.
riddle_note: Traditional-style descriptive riddle; suitable for children and folk riddle context.

riddle_original: 艇仔合艇仔，入面有兩個孖仔。估一種農作物。
riddle_english: One little boat joins another little boat, with a pair of twins inside. Guess a crop.
riddle_hint: The little boats refer to the peanut shell; the twins are the two peanut kernels inside.
riddle_note: Traditional-style descriptive riddle, suitable for children and folk riddle context.

riddle_original: 青布包白布，白布包蝦，蝦包醋。打一植物。
riddle_english: Green cloth wraps white cloth; white cloth wraps shrimp; shrimp wraps vinegar. Guess a plant.
riddle_hint: Green cloth = outer peel; white cloth = white pith; shrimp = segment-shaped flesh; vinegar = sour taste.
riddle_note: 畢椂 is a Cantonese/local name for pomelo.

riddle_original: 細時着鞋着襪，大時披頭散髮。打一植物。
riddle_english: When young, it wears shoes and socks; when grown, its hair hangs loose. Guess a plant.
riddle_hint: Young corn is wrapped neatly in green husks; mature corn shows loose corn silk at the top.
riddle_note: Traditional-style descriptive plant riddle, suitable for children and folk riddle context.

riddle_original: 一條棍仔頂塊瓦，公婆仔乸跔地下。打一植物。
riddle_english: A little stick holds up a tile; old men, old women, boys, and girls crouch underground. Guess a plant.
riddle_hint: The stick is the long leaf stalk; the tile is the broad taro leaf; taros of all sizes grow low or underground.
riddle_note: Traditional-style descriptive plant riddle using vivid rural imagery.

riddle_original: 食乜嘢昆蟲會瘦？
riddle_english: Which insect would make you thin if you ate it?
riddle_hint: 食蟻獸 means anteater, but sounds like 食蟻瘦, meaning eating ants makes you thin.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone joke; 乜嘢 means what.

riddle_original: 咩水果最不保值？
riddle_english: Which fruit holds its value the least?
riddle_hint: 蕉 sounds like 朝 in 朝不保夕, meaning uncertain from morning to evening.
riddle_note: Light Cantonese homophone riddle based on a common idiom.

riddle_original: 咩嘢動物一世都唔識長高？
riddle_english: Which animal never grows taller in its whole life?
riddle_hint: 龜苓膏 sounds like 龜零高, meaning a turtle with zero height.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone joke based on the dessert name turtle jelly.

riddle_original: 學生最怕乜嘢魚？
riddle_english: Which fish are students most afraid of?
riddle_hint: 東星斑 sounds like Don't 升班, meaning do not advance to the next grade.
riddle_note: Cantonese-English code-mixed pun involving a fish name and school promotion.

riddle_original: 紅門框，白蚊帳，入面有個癲和尚。估一人體部位。
riddle_english: A red doorframe, a white mosquito net, and a mad monk inside. Guess a body part.
riddle_hint: The red frame is the lips, the white net is the teeth, and the mad monk is the tongue.
riddle_note: Traditional children's body-part riddle.

riddle_original: 話說有架飛機畀人劫咗，啲乘客會對劫機者講啲咩呢？估一手機品牌。
riddle_english: A plane has been hijacked. What would the passengers say to the hijacker? Guess a mobile phone brand.
riddle_hint: Cantonese pun: 落機呀 means get off the plane and sounds like Nokia.
riddle_note: Requires Cantonese pronunciation and knowledge of the mobile phone brand Nokia.

riddle_original: 鯊魚食咗紅豆會變咩嘢？
riddle_english: What does a shark become after eating red beans?
riddle_hint: 紅豆鯊 sounds like 紅豆沙, a red bean dessert soup or paste.
riddle_note: Cantonese food pun based on a familiar dessert name.

riddle_original: 邊種機器辦事效率最低？
riddle_english: Which machine is the least efficient at getting things done?
riddle_hint: 拖拉 means to procrastinate or work slowly; 拖拉機 means tractor.
riddle_note: Cantonese/Chinese wordplay based on the literal components of the machine name.

riddle_original: 餐具上火架，估一食物。
riddle_english: A piece of tableware is put over the fire. Guess a food.
riddle_hint: 叉 means fork or skewer; 燒 means roasted or burned, forming 叉燒.
riddle_note: Wordplay on the written components of the food name char siu.

riddle_original: 緝毒犬放工，猜一職業。
riddle_english: A drug-sniffing dog gets off work. Guess an occupation.
riddle_hint: 文員 sounds like 聞完, meaning finished smelling or sniffing.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone joke involving a common office occupation.

riddle_original: 大哥住山南，二哥住山北，感情雖是好，終身見唔得。估一人體部位。
riddle_english: Elder brother lives south of the mountain, second brother lives north; though close, they can never meet. Guess a body part.
riddle_hint: The two ears are on opposite sides of the head.
riddle_note: Traditional children's body-part riddle.

riddle_original: 十個兄弟結個社，頭上各頂一片瓦，小事分開兩家做，大事齊心也不怕。估一人體部位。
riddle_english: Ten brothers form a society, each carrying a little roof on top; for small tasks they split into two families, for big tasks they join forces. Guess a body part.
riddle_hint: The ten fingers have nails; two hands can work separately or together.
riddle_note: Traditional children's body-part riddle.

riddle_original: 珍珠玉女香噴噴，嫁個窮夫竹葉君。五花大綁投河死，明朝解去入衙門。估一食物。
riddle_english: A fragrant pearl-like maiden marries poor Mister Bamboo Leaf; tied up tightly and thrown into the river, then untied and brought to court tomorrow. Guess a food.
riddle_hint: Glutinous rice is wrapped in bamboo leaves, tied, boiled, then unwrapped to eat.
riddle_note: Traditional food riddle about zongzi.

riddle_original: 殺手最中意用咩番欖沖涼？
riddle_english: What kind of olive does a killer most like to bathe with?
riddle_hint: 番欖 or olive plus bathing points to 梘, soap, which sounds like 鐧 in 殺手鐧.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone pun pointing to the expression 殺手鐧.

riddle_original: 輯毒犬放工，估一職業。
riddle_english: What is the profession position for narcotics dog getting off work?

riddle_original: 阿茂整餅咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Ah Mou making cakes" mean?
riddle_hint: Refers to making whichever cake is missing; by extension, creating work where there was none.
riddle_note: Cantonese xiehouyu linked to an old Guangzhou/Xiguan teahouse story; often mildly negative.

riddle_original: 老鼠搵貓咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a mouse looking for a cat" mean?
riddle_hint: A mouse seeking out a cat is bringing trouble upon itself.
riddle_note: Cantonese saying meaning to invite trouble or court disaster.

riddle_original: 刀仔鋸大樹咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "using a little knife to saw down a big tree" mean?
riddle_hint: Using a small tool or limited effort to take on something much bigger.
riddle_note: Can be used positively to mean achieving a large result with limited means.

riddle_original: 黃皮樹鷯哥咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the myna bird on a wampee tree" mean?
riddle_hint: The bird eats only ripe wampee fruit; 熟 also means familiar or acquainted.
riddle_note: Means someone only cheats or takes advantage of people they know.

riddle_original: 阿崩叫狗咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Ah Bang calling a dog" mean?
riddle_hint: A person missing front teeth calls the dog unclearly, so the dog thinks it is being driven away.
riddle_note: Means someone or something becomes less obedient the more you call.

riddle_original: 狐狸嗌交咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "foxes arguing" mean?
riddle_hint: Pun on 狐, fox, and 胡 in 胡言, meaning nonsense.
riddle_note: Cantonese/Chinese character pun meaning complete nonsense.

riddle_original: 姜太公封神咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Jiang Taigong appointing the gods" mean?
riddle_hint: Jiang Taigong grants titles to others but leaves himself out.
riddle_note: Refers to doing things for others with a selfless spirit; from the Fengshen tradition.

riddle_original: 太公分豬肉咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the clan elder dividing pork" mean?
riddle_hint: In Cantonese ancestral rites, pork offerings are divided among clan members.
riddle_note: Means everyone gets some share or benefit and no one is left out.

riddle_original: 灶君跌落鑊咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the Kitchen God falling into the wok" mean?
riddle_hint: 蒸神 means steamed god and sounds like 精神, meaning energetic or spirited.
riddle_note: Cantonese homophone pun involving the Kitchen God and cooking imagery.

riddle_original: 吹打佬跌利是咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a wind-instrument performer dropping his red packet" mean?
riddle_hint: The performer has wasted breath and lost the reward.
riddle_note: Means talking, arguing, or advising in vain, especially with someone unreasonable.

riddle_original: 乾隆皇契仔，估一句俗語/人物名。
riddle_english: Qianlong Emperor's godson. Guess a Cantonese expression or character name.
riddle_hint: From the popular novel 乾隆遊江南; 周日 can imply every day, and 清 means cleared out.
riddle_note: 周日清 refers to spending all one's daily income with no savings.

riddle_original: 桂姐賣布咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Sister Kwai selling cloth" mean?
riddle_hint: 匹 sounds like 筆, so one bolt of cloth becomes one account or item.
riddle_note: Means accounts or issues should be kept separate and clearly distinguished.

riddle_original: 土地燈籠咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the Earth God’s lantern" mean?
riddle_hint: Lanterns for the Earth God were left up until morning during traditional worship.
riddle_note: Refers to someone who enjoys nightlife and stays out all night.

riddle_original: 三元宮土地咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "the Earth God of Sanyuan Temple" mean?
riddle_hint: The statue was said to be made of tin, 錫, which sounds like 惜, to cherish or protect.
riddle_note: Means being overly protective of oneself or unwilling to work hard.

riddle_original: 趁墟賣魚尾咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "selling fish tails at a rural market" mean?
riddle_hint: Fishmongers would only sell a fish tail together with the fish mouth or head; 搭嘴 also means to butt in.
riddle_note: Used to describe someone who likes to join conversations uninvited.

riddle_original: 鼎湖上素咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "Dinghu vegetarian deluxe" mean?
riddle_hint: 鼎湖上素 is a famous vegetarian dish from Dinghu Mountain and Qingyun Temple in Zhaoqing.
riddle_note: In Cantonese, 齋 can mean vegetarian or plain, but also no benefit to gain or monotonous.

riddle_original: 冇檳榔嚼出汁，估一成語。
riddle_english: Chewing out juice without any betel nut in the mouth. Guess an idiom.
riddle_hint: If there is no betel nut but juice is still produced by chewing, something has appeared from nothing.
riddle_note: Betel nut chewing was traditionally associated with refreshment and digestion.

riddle_original: 手扶拖拉機咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a hand tractor" mean?
riddle_hint: 屎 can mean poor or lousy; 巴閉 means acting impressive, boastful, or full of oneself.
riddle_note: Describes someone who is both incompetent and boastful.

riddle_original: 公共電話咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a public telephone" mean?
reference_answer_original: 有錢有得傾，冇錢冇得傾
riddle_hint: 傾 means to talk; a public phone only works after money is inserted.
riddle_note: Mocks people who only care about money and ignore goodwill or principle.

riddle_original: 狗仔抬轎咩意思？
riddle_english: What does "a little dog carrying a sedan chair" mean?
riddle_hint: A dog cannot literally lift a sedan chair; 抬舉 also means to value, promote, or show favor to someone.
riddle_note: Means failing to appreciate someone's kindness, favor, or recognition.

riddle_original: 蓋喺每枚本地硬幣同郵票上面嘅英國皇冠標誌
riddle_english: The British crown symbol stamped on every local coin and postage stamp
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 議員的空承諾
riddle_english: A politician's empty promises
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 會場鼓掌湊人數
riddle_english: Packing a convention hall with extra bodies just to get applause
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 斧頭劈開新天地，鐮刀割斷舊塵緣
riddle_english: An axe splits open a brand-new world, a sickle cuts through the ties of the old era
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 選舉拉票畫大餅
riddle_english: Passing a decree in the morning only to change it by evening
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 只要一提到佢，佢就即刻喺你面前出現
riddle_english: The exact second you mention him, he appears
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 呢位前最高領導人戴住一副厚厚嘅黑框眼鏡，網民仲將佢標籤為「蟾蜍」
riddle_english: This former paramount leader wears a pair of thick black-rimmed glasses, and netizens even label him as a "Toad."
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 一位威猛嘅者喺戰爭中被捕，坐落去一個好迫嘅四方細字監牢裏面
riddle_english: A supreme King is captured during a political coup and locked behind the four tight walls of a square prison cell
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 邊個係「我哋心目中嘅紅太陽」
riddle_english: Who is the "Red Sun in our hearts"?
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 邊一隻卡通熊最叻做國家主席？
riddle_english: Which cartoon bear is the absolute best at being the State Chairman?
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 三个臭皮匠
riddle_english: Three humble craftsman
riddle_hint: This is a two-part riddle (歇后语) that uses a clever visual metaphor to create a funny punchline.
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 一把聖誕夜嘅火，燒出咗幾十萬人嘅新家
riddle_english: A Christmas Eve fire burned a new home into existence for hundreds of thousands
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 呢位醫生唔救病人，專救國家，喺香港密謀，推翻皇帝
riddle_english: This doctor didn't heal patients; he healed a nation, plotting from Hong Kong to topple an emperor
riddle_note: Can be understood by Mandarin and Cantonese Chinese speakers, but uses Cantonese text

riddle_original: 我係一條路，唔係為行人而建，我運嘅唔係人，係令西方人著迷嘅布料
riddle_english: I am a road not built for walkers; I carried fabric that dazzled the West
riddle_note: Can be understood by Mandarin and Cantonese Chinese speakers, but uses Cantonese text

riddle_original: 我有九千九百九十九間房，但從來唔歡迎普通客人
riddle_english: I have 9,999 rooms but never welcomed ordinary guests
riddle_note: Can be understood by Mandarin and Cantonese Chinese speakers, but uses Cantonese text

riddle_original: 評話說三國
riddle_english: A master storyteller narrating the Three Kingdoms saga
riddle_note: Can be understood by Mandarin and Cantonese Chinese speakers, but uses Cantonese text

riddle_original: 周瑜打黃蓋
riddle_english: General Zhou Yu beating old general Huang Gai
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 劉備借荊州
riddle_english: Liu Bei borrowing Jingzhou province
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 孔夫子搬家
riddle_english: Confucius moving his house
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 劉備請諸葛亮
riddle_english: Liu Bei inviting Zhuge Liang to join his cause
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 呢度以前係一個黑社會橫行, 而家變成咗一個平靜嘅草地公園
riddle_english: What used to be an underworld rampage has become a peaceful grassy park
riddle_note: Can be understood by Mandarin and Cantonese Chinese speakers, but uses Cantonese text

riddle_original: 長江黃河入大海
riddle_english: The Yangtze and Yellow Rivers empting into the massive ocean
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 喺一條陰暗嘅天橋底，啲婆婆用拖鞋拍打紙人
riddle_english: Under a dark flyover, old ladies slam slippers onto paper cutouts
riddle_note: Can be understood by Mandarin and Cantonese Chinese speakers, but uses Cantonese text

riddle_original: 喜馬拉雅山望泰山
riddle_english: Looking out at Mount Tai from the apex of the Himalayas
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 洞庭湖的水
riddle_english: The deep waters of Dongting Lake
riddle_note: Can be understood by Mandarin and Cantonese Chinese speakers, but uses Cantonese text

riddle_original: 呢個喺泥灘上用木樁起嘅寧靜西方漁村
riddle_english: This tranquil western fishing village built with stakes on the mudflats
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 死海游水
riddle_english: Swimming in the dead sea
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 船出長江口
riddle_english: A boat finally sailing out from the mouth of the Yangtze River
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 錢塘江漲大潮
riddle_english: The massive tidal bore rising on the Qiantang River
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 呢個細小嘅沿海城市，每晚吸引幾百萬人過嚟轉輪盤、擲骰子,
riddle_english: A tiny coastal city attracting millions of people all night long to spin wheels and roll dice.
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 邊個最叻將時間調慢到「0.01公分」?
riddle_english: Who is the absolute master of slowing time down to "0.01 centimeters,"?
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 湖邊秋色映畫中
riddle_english: Autumn colors by the lake reflected inside a painting
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 半堤楊柳入丹青
riddle_english: Half a riverbank of weeping willows entering a painting
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 邊位電影大師打交唔用真刀真槍，反而鍾意將體操成一場搞笑嘅舞步?
riddle_english: Which movie master uses no real weapons in a fight, choosing instead to turn acrobatics
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 一位著黑色長衫嘅宗師快速打木人樁，要一次過打十個
riddle_english: A master in a black gown quickly struck the wooden man's stakes, ten at a time
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 方才進店沒出聲
riddle_english: Just entered the shop without making a sound
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 表面係一隻皮鞋，但實際上係一個風筒嘅經典特務電影道具
riddle_english: A secret agent movie prop shaped like a leather shoe that actually functions as a hair dryer
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 開口唱古今，台上演悲歡
riddle_english: Opening the mouth to sing of past and present, staging joy and sorrow on the platform
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 他最叻將市井小人物變成功夫高手同埋足球冠軍
riddle_english: He is best at turning everday losers into kung fu masters and football champions
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 一條眼不見、手摸不到嘅線，但每晚都可以將幾百萬香港人死死綁喺屋企
riddle_english: An invisible, wireless string that can completely tie down millions of Hong Kong citizens at nigh
riddle_note: Cantonese Chinese; Hong Kong

riddle_original: 水龙头没拧紧
riddle_english: The water tap is leaking and wasn't screwed on tightly
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 特點係近距離連環衝拳同埋防守中線嘅武術流派
riddle_english: The martial arts style featuring close-range chain punches and center-line defense
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 一位田徑精英「人」高高躍起，成個身飛過一個好高嘅木製「山」形跨欄
riddle_english: An elite track athlete (人) leaps high into the air, flying cleanly over a tall wooden mountain hurdle (山)
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 一條長長嘅木「舟」喺江河上行駛，但一陣巨浪「氵」打中佢嘅右邊，將佢嘅船槳衝走，連船身都撞斷埋
riddle_english: A long wooden boat (舟) sails down the river, but a massive tidal wave (氵) hits its right flank, tossing away its paddle and snapping its spine
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 网路不通
riddle_english: The internet network is completely disconnected
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 倒拔垂杨柳
riddle_english: Uprooting a weeping willow tree with bare hands
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 四书六艺都精通
riddle_english: Perfectly mastering the Four Books of Confucianism and all Six Classical Arts
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 万山红遍
riddle_english: Ten thousand mountains completely covered in a blanket of blazing crimson red
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 半把剪刀
riddle_english: Exactly half of a pair of scissors
riddle_note: Understood by all Chinese speakers across regions

riddle_original: 三八二十四
riddle_english: Three times eight equals twenty-four
riddle_note: Mandarin Chinese

riddle_original: 中秋節應該買邊隻股票?
