riddle_english: It can be seen, but not touched.

riddle_original: मातीविना उगवला कापूस लाख मन पडला मुसळधार पाऊस तरीही भिजला नाही
riddle_english: Cotton grew without soil; heavy rain fell, yet it did not get wet.

riddle_original: मी नेहमी तिथेच असतो तुम्ही मला फक्त दिवसाच पाहू शकता
riddle_english: I am always there, but you can see me only during the day.

riddle_original: सुपभर लाह्या त्यात एक रुपया
riddle_english: A tray full of puffed rice, with one rupee in it.

riddle_original: अशी कोणती जागा आहे जिकडे रस्ता आहे पण गाडी नाही जंगल आहे पण झाड नाही
riddle_english: What place has roads but no vehicles, and forests but no trees?

riddle_original: अशा एका गोष्टीच नाव सांग जी आपल्या आजूबाजूला असते पण दिसत नाही?
riddle_english: Name something that is all around us but cannot be seen.

riddle_original: एवढीशी नन्नुबाय, साऱ्या वाटणं गीत गाय।
riddle_english: A tiny little one sings songs along every path.

riddle_original: गाणं गातो पण आवाज नाही.
riddle_english: It sings songs but has no voice of its own.

riddle_original: झोपला की उठवतो, पण कधी झोपत नाही.
riddle_english: It wakes you when you are asleep, but it never sleeps.

riddle_original: बारीक असते लांब पण असते तरीही मी काठी नाही
riddle_english: It is thin and long, but it is not a stick.

riddle_original: मी कोनासोबतच भांडत नाही तरी सुद्धा लोक मला मारत बसतात?
riddle_english: I do not fight with anyone, yet people keep hitting me.

riddle_original: शाळेत जातो पण शिकत नाही.
riddle_english: It goes to school but does not learn.

riddle_original: भिंतीवर माझे जग उभे राहते; वर्तुळ, त्रिकोण, रेषा, आणि गावकुसातील जीवन.
riddle_english: My world stands on the wall; circles, triangles, lines, and village life.

riddle_original: ढोलकीच्या ठेक्यावर शब्द नाचतात; समाज, प्रेम, विनोद, राजकारण सगळे माझ्या लयीला येते.
riddle_english: Words dance to the beat of the drum; society, love, humor, politics, everything fits my rhythm.

riddle_original: गाणे, नृत्य, संवाद, विनोद, सोंगाड्या आणि रंगमंच; गावोगावी फिरणारे लोकनाट्य.
riddle_english: Song, dance, dialogue, comedy, songs and theatre; a folk theatre that travels from village to village.

riddle_original: टाळ-मृदंग घेऊन चालणारी भक्ती; पाय धुळीत, नाव विठ्ठलाचे.
riddle_english: Devotion that walks with a tambourine and a mridangam; feet in the dust, the name is Vitthal.

riddle_original: एका टेबलावर काय ठेवले जाते जे कट केले जाते, परंतु कधीच खाल्ले जात नाही?
riddle_english: What is placed on a table and cut, but never eaten?

riddle_original: चार खंडांचा एक शहर, चार विहीरी बीना पानी
riddle_english: A city of four sections, with four wells but no water.

riddle_original: पंख नाहीत मला तरीही मी हवेत उडते
riddle_english: I have no wings, yet I fly in the air.

riddle_original: दादरमध्ये जन्म, वानखेड्यावर निरोप; शतकांचे शतक करणारा क्रिकेटचा लहानसा महापर्वत.
riddle_english: Born in Dadar, farewell at Wankheda; a small giant of cricket who scored centuries of centuries.

riddle_original: साताऱ्याच्या मातीतला पैलवान; हेलसिंकीत कांस्य घेऊन स्वतंत्र भारताला वैयक्तिक ऑलिम्पिक मान दिला.
riddle_english: A wrestler from Satara's soil; won bronze in Helsinki, giving independent India individual Olympic honor.

riddle_original: दक्षिण मुंबईतील मैदान; २०११ चा जयघोष माझ्या छातीवर झाला.
riddle_english: The ground in South Mumbai; the cheers of 2011 were on my chest.

riddle_original: श्वास रोखून हल्ला, रेषा ओलांडून परत; महाराष्ट्रात नियमांना आधुनिक आकार मिळालेला खेळ.
riddle_english: Attack while holding your breath, return after crossing the line; a game whose rules have taken on a modern shape in Maharashtra.

riddle_original: पाठलाग, वेग, “खो”चा आवाज; मैदानात बुद्धी आणि चपळाई दोन्हीची परीक्षा.
riddle_english: The chase, the speed, the sound of “Kho”; a test of both intelligence and agility in the field.

riddle_original: चार खंडांचा शहर, १८ चोर, १ राणी...
riddle_english: A city of four continents, 18 thieves, 1 queen...

riddle_original: तोडल्यावर खूश होतो, सतत तोडावेसे वाटते?
riddle_english: Do you feel happy when you break it, or do you constantly want to break it?

riddle_original: कुट कुट काडी पोटात नाडी, राम जन्मला हातजोडी, कृष्ण जन्मला हात जोडी।
riddle_english: A devotional instrument in the shrine that is struck with joined hands.

riddle_original: सगळीकडे आहे उजेड आणि गाणी मी तर आहे सणांची राणी
riddle_english: There is light and song everywhere; I am the queen of festivals.

riddle_original: दगडात खोदलेले शांत बौद्ध जग; रंग अजून बोलतात, भिंती अजून कथा सांगतात.
riddle_english: A serene Buddhist world carved in stone; Colors still speak, walls still tell stories.

riddle_original: एका पर्वताला मंदिर बनवले; बौद्ध, हिंदू, जैन वाटा एकाच दगडात भेटल्या.
riddle_english: A mountain was turned into a temple; Buddhist, Hindu, and Jain paths met in a single stone.

riddle_original: हिरव्या गावांच्या भिंतींवर पांढऱ्या रेषांतून जग रंगवणारी आदिवासी स्मृती.
riddle_english: Tribal memory that paints the world through white lines on the walls of green villages.

riddle_original: लाटांशी लढणारा किल्ला; समुद्रच माझी खंदकरेषा, आणि शिवकाल माझी ओळख.
riddle_english: A fortress that fights the waves; the sea is my trench line, and Shivakal is my identity.

riddle_original: एका धान्याचे नाव जे तीर्थक्षेत्र आहे?
riddle_english: What is the name of a grain that is a pilgrimage site?

riddle_original: भाजीत प्रसिद्ध शहराचे नाव लपलेले?
riddle_english: Is the name of a famous city hidden in a vegetable?

riddle_original: एका डोंगरात देव, धर्म आणि शिल्प यांचा मेळा; कैलास इथे दगडातून जन्मला.
riddle_english: A gathering of gods, religion and sculpture in one mountain; Kailash was born here from stone.

riddle_original: मुंबईपासून समुद्र ओलांडला की माझ्या दगडात शिवाचे तीन चेहरे शांत उभे दिसतात.
riddle_english: When I cross the sea from Mumbai, I see three faces of Shiva standing peacefully in my stone.

riddle_original: अशी कोणती गोष्ट आहे जी नेहमीच वाढत जाते परंतु कधीही कमी होत नाही?
riddle_english: What always increases and never decreases?

riddle_original: अशी कोणती गोष्ट आहे तुमची जी बाकीचे लोक तुमच्यापेक्षा जास्त वापरतात ?
riddle_english: What belongs to you, but other people use it more than you do?

riddle_original: अशी कोणी गोष्ट आहे ज्याला Head आणि Tail आहे पण Body नाही आहे?
riddle_english: What has a head and a tail, but no body?

riddle_original: असे कोणते फळ आहे, जे बाजारात विकले जात नाही?
riddle_english: Which fruit is not sold in the market?

riddle_original: एक माणूस चालत होता आणि पाऊस पडला पण त्याच्या डोक्यावरचा एक केसही ओला झाला नाही
riddle_english: A man was walking and it rained, but not a single hair on his head got wet.

riddle_original: एका माणसाचे चार अक्षरी नाव काय? ज्याचे पहिले व दुसरे अक्षर म्हणजे त्याच्या बायकोचे नाव ! दुसरे व तिसरे अक्षर म्हणजे त्याच्या मुलाचे नाव तिसरे व चौथे अक्षर म्हणजे त्याच्या मुलाचे नाव व चारही अक्षर म्हणजे त्याचे नाव सांगा पाहु ते नाव काय?
riddle_english: What is a man's four-letter name where the first part is his wife's name, the middle part is his child's name, and all four letters form his name?

riddle_original: कोणती संख्या जोडली तरी वाढत नाही आणि वजा केली तरी कमी होत नाही?
riddle_english: Which number does not increase when added and does not decrease when subtracted?

riddle_original: नाव घेतलं की नाहीशी होते.
riddle_english: It disappears when its name is spoken.

riddle_original: प्रत्येकाकडे मी आहे आणि माझ्याशिवाय तुम्ही लांब जाऊ शकत नाही
riddle_english: Everyone has me, and without me you cannot go far.

riddle_original: असा एका प्राण्याचे नाव सांगा जो जखमी झाल्यावर माणसाप्रमाणे रडतो?
riddle_english: Name an animal that cries like a human when it is hurt.

riddle_original: अशी कोणती गोष्ट आहे जिला माणूस लपवून चालतो, पण स्त्रिया दाखवून चालतात?
riddle_english: What does a man hide while walking, but women show while walking?

riddle_original: असा कोण आहे जो तुमच्या नाकावर बसून तुमचे कान पकडतो?
riddle_english: Who sits on your nose and holds your ears?

riddle_original: आम्ही दोघे जुळे भाऊ एकाच रंगाचे आणि एकच उंचीचे
riddle_english: We are twin brothers of the same color and the same height.

riddle_original: चार बोटे आणि एक अंगठा तरीही माझ्या नसांमध्ये रक्त नाही
riddle_english: Four fingers and one thumb, yet there is no blood in my veins.

riddle_original: डोळा असून सुद्धा मी पाहू शकत नाही
riddle_english: I have an eye, but I cannot see.

riddle_original: दात आहेत पण चावत नाही
riddle_english: It has teeth but does not bite.

riddle_original: ना खातो मी अन्न ना घेतो मी तुमच्याकडून पगार तरीही देतो पहारा दिवस रात्र
riddle_english: I eat no food and take no salary from you, yet I keep watch day and night.

riddle_original: मला आहेत तीन हात, माझे पोट आहे गोल
riddle_english: I have three hands, and my stomach is round.

riddle_original: माझ्यात एवढी ताकद आहे की मी लोखंडाला सुद्धा खेचू शकतो
riddle_english: I am so powerful that I can even pull iron.

riddle_original: मी कधीही आजारी पडत नाही तरीसुद्धा लोक मला गोळी देतात
riddle_english: Even though I never get sick, people still give me pills.

riddle_original: ऊनात चालताना मी येतो सावलीत बसता मी जातो वाऱ्याचा स्पर्श मला नकोसा वाटतो सांगा पाहू मी कोण
riddle_english: i come while walking in the sun, go while in shadow, and I don't like the touch of the air

riddle_original: अस काय आहे जे तुमचे बोलून झाल्यावर वेगळे होऊन जातात?
riddle_english: What separates after you finish speaking?

riddle_original: असे काय आहे जे तुम्ही झोपता तेव्हा ती सुद्धा पडते आणि जेव्हा तुम्ही उठता तेव्हा ती सुद्धा उठते?
riddle_english: What falls when you sleep and rises when you wake up?

riddle_original: असे काय आहे, ज्याचं येणं पण खराब आहे आणि ज्याचं जाणे पण खराब आहे?
riddle_english: What is it that is bad to come and bad to go?

riddle_original: आपल्या डाव्या हातामध्ये आपण जे ठेवू शकता ते आपल्या उजव्या हातावर कधीही ठेवू शकत नाही.
riddle_english: What can you put in your left hand that you can never put on your right hand?

riddle_original: काळा आहे पण कावळा नाही लांब आहे पण साप नाही फुले वाहतात पण देव नाही
riddle_english: It is black but not a crow; long but not a snake; flowers are worn on it, but it is not a god.

riddle_original: कोणती गोष्ट तुटते पण आवाज करत नाही?
riddle_english: What breaks without making a sound?

riddle_original: जे काय आहे जे पंखापेक्षा अधिक हलका आहे, परंतु जगातील सर्वात बलवान माणूस देखील त्याला जास्त काळ धरून शकत नाही?
riddle_english: What is lighter than a feather, but even the strongest person in the world cannot hold it for long?

riddle_original: दोन भाऊ शेजारी, भेट नाही जन्मांतरी…
riddle_english: Two brothers live next to each other, but they never meet in their lifetime.

riddle_original: मी एकमेव अवयव आहे ज्याने माझे स्वतःच स्वतःचे नाव ठेवले आहे.
riddle_english: I am the only organ that named itself.

riddle_original: अशी कोणती गोष्ट आहे, जिला वापरण्याआधी तोडावे लागते?
riddle_english: What must be broken before it can be used?

riddle_original: एक काळा घोडा त्यावर बसली पांढरी स्वारी
riddle_english: A black horse with a white rider sitting on it.

riddle_original: तीन पायांची एक तीपाले बसला त्यावर एक शिपाई
riddle_english: A three-legged stand with a soldier sitting on it.

riddle_original: नेहमी पोटात आग, पण उपयोगी.
riddle_english: There is always fire in its belly, but it is useful.

riddle_original: पांढरे माझे पातेले त्यात ठेवला पिवळा भात
riddle_english: A white pot with yellow rice inside it.

riddle_original: मी गोष्ट कशी आहे जी फ्रीजमध्ये ठेवून सुद्धा गरमच राहणार
riddle_english: What will stay hot even if it is kept in the refrigerator?

riddle_original: लोक मला खाण्यासाठी विकत घेतात, पण ते मला कधीही खात नाहीत
riddle_english: People buy me for eating, but they never eat me.

riddle_original: वस्तू आहे मी अशी छिद्रे असतानाही पाणी भरून मी घेते
riddle_english: I am an object that can hold water even though I have holes.

riddle_original: सांगा बर असे कोण आहे जे फाटते पण त्यातून आवाज येत नाही?
riddle_english: Tell me, who is there who is torn but makes no sound?

riddle_original: हा बागेत भेटत नाही, पण हा अर्धा फुल आणि अर्धा फळ आहे
riddle_english: It is not found in a garden, but it is half flower and half fruit.

riddle_original: Akuoy in momomarentah molantud Kon lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow, sinangoyan Ki ine akuoy...
riddle_english: I am the almighty ruler of the Mongondow region. What is my name?

riddle_original: Akuoy mo ahli Kon urusan in tundi bo mongongundam, no bali' intaw modiyug ko i raja...Ki Ine akuoy...
riddle_english:
I am the companion of a bogani; I am often referred to by those who understand astrology, 
experts in diseases and their treatments. Who am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy in punu' molantud pertama Kon Bolaang Mongondow, Yo Ki Ine in akuoy?
riddle_english: know astrology often refer to me. Who am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy intau pertama kon bumi bolaang mongondow, Ki ine in akuoy?
riddle_english:
I am the first resident of 
Bolaang Mongondow. Who am I?

riddle_original: Sinangoyan Ki Ine in keluarga turunan in raja Kon Bolaang Mongondow ..
riddle_english: What is the term for the royal family in Bolaang Mongondow?

riddle_original: Akuoy in punu' molantud terakhir Kon lopa' in Bolaang mongondow siapa aku?
riddle_english:
I am the last king of Bolaang 
Mongondow, Who am i

riddle_original: Akuoy in momimpin Kon poyosipunan in masyarakat, sinangoyan onu akuoy...
riddle_english: I am the leader of a community organization. What is my title?

riddle_original: Onu Mako in syarat mojadi bogani ?
riddle_english: What are the essential qualities that a bogani must possess?
riddle_note: There are 4 requirements to become a bogani (Leader of the society)

riddle_original: Onu in paloko bo Ki kinalang tuwa?
riddle_english: What do “paloko” and “kinalang” mean?

riddle_original: Kon masa raja Ki Ine in mulai nomake in gelar raja?
riddle_english: When did the title of “datu” or “king” first come into use?

riddle_original: Puya' bagu no i lahir bo nodiya Kon takit biasa tangoyan Ki Ine...
riddle_english: What was the name given to the child who had been sickly since birth?

riddle_original: Puya' no i lahir Kon bonu in peristiwa moloben biasa tangoyan Ki Ine...
riddle_english: What is the name given to a child born on the day of a major event?

riddle_original: Akuoy in keturunan raja bo datu' Kon lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow, akuoy kinumaday Kon agama Islam, Ki Ine tangoyku..
riddle_english:
I am a member of a noble family who practices 
Islam in the Mongondow region.Who am I?

riddle_original: Parang no terjadi Kon tahun 1903-1904 Kon bonu in pomarentahan i Sangadi lipu pontodon tangoynya Ki Eman. Onu tangoy parang tatuwa...
riddle_english: The battle led by Sangadi Eman of Pontondon in 1903–1904 Is that called a war?

riddle_original: Kon taong tongonu in agama Islam no i angoy Kon lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: In what year did Islam arrive in Bolaang Mongondow?

riddle_original: Akuoy in pulau no intok no i lahir Kon bencana moloben Kon Bolaang Mongondow kolipod. Kon bonu in 40 no singgay uyan bo tompot moloben noko pilat ko i nako takin bulud in babo'..pulau onu tangoy ku?
riddle_english:
I am the island formed by the greatest natural disaster in Bolaang Mongondow. It rained for 40 days, accompanied by
lightning, thunder, and a violent storm, which caused Mount Babo to split apart and give birth to me. What is the name
of this island?

riddle_original: Akuoy in nodiya Kon agama Islam Kon lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow. Akuoy nonikah ko i putri raja bo nomiya Kon agama Islam no bali' agama Kon kerajaan. Ki Ine akuoy...
riddle_english:
I was the one who introduced Islam to the Kingdom of Bolaang Mongondow; I married the king’s daughter 
and succeeded in establishing Islam as the state religion. What is my name?

riddle_original: Akuoy Budaya leluhur yang salalu Aidan in masyarakat Bolaang mongondow Kotompodan in dolom 26,27,28 Kon bonu in bulan  puasa , sinangoyan onu in akuoy...
riddle_english:
What is the tradition commonly practiced by the Bolaang Mongondow community on the 26th, 27th, and 28th nights
of Ramadan?

riddle_original: Masa pinonguasaan in raja-raja Kon Bolaang Mongondow, nongkon raja pertama sampe Don Kon raja ko onom in sinangoyan masa onu in tuwa....
riddle_english:
The period during which the kings ruled Bolaang Mongondow, from the reign of the first king
to the sixth king, is known as the...

riddle_original: Akuoy pinercaya i raja Kon pomarentahannya bo bali' totaba' i raja mopodapot in parentah Kon ata bo masyarakat in lipu', sinangoyan Ki Ine akuoy...
riddle_english:
The chief executive of the government represents the king and serves as the king’s liaison with other government officials
and the people. What is this position called?

riddle_original: Kon onda tampat pinogutunan guyanga tungkul tua?
riddle_english: Where did the ancestors of the Bolaang Mongondow tribe live?

riddle_original: kon onda pinonampatan karajaan i raja kon abad 17 modapot kon abad 19
riddle_english: Where was the king's palace located from the 17th century to the late 19th century?

riddle_original:
akuoi noiukat kon utara buta’ pulau sulawesi, ilumanggo nongkon barat nadapot kon timur bo noiukat kon yuak in kabupaten 
gonontalon bo minahasa. Onu tangoi tampatku?
riddle_english:
I am located in the northern part of Sulawesi Island, stretching from west to east and bordered
by two other regencies, namely Gorontalo and Minahasa. Which region am I in?

riddle_original: Onu tangoy 'Ki Ina in lipu lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow'
riddle_english: What is the capital city of Bolaang Mongondow Regency?

riddle_original: kon onda tampat pertama in pinosindogan kon karajaan bolaang mongodow?
riddle_english: Where was the first capital of the Bolaang Mongondow Kingdom located?

riddle_original: kon taong 1480 m pinamping in tampat kerajaan bolaang mongondow, kon ondakah tampat ini pinomampingan kerajaan
riddle_english:
In 1480 AD, the capital of the Bolaang Mongondow Kingdom was relocated. Where was the Bolaang Mongondow Kingdom
located after the relocation?

riddle_original:
kon onda tampat in pinomampingan karajaan bolaang mongondow i raja laloda taong 1665 M sin salalu
poyotuluon in balanda
riddle_english:
Where did King Laloda relocate the capital of the Bolaang Mongondow Kingdom in 1665 AD 
after becoming deeply troubled by the Dutch’s attempts to sow discord?

riddle_original: kon masa pomarentahan i raja yakobus manoppo, tampat in kerajaan pinamping kon onda?
riddle_english: During the reign of King Yakobus Manoppo, where was the seat of the kingdom moved?

riddle_original: Kon onda ki Raja Salomon Manoppo binuni walu notaong ko onggotnya ?
riddle_english: Where was King Solomon Manoppo exiled for eight years?

riddle_original: kon onda in tampat danau moat ?
riddle_english: Where is the moat lake located?

riddle_original: Akuoy in pinomiya nongkon bahan logam, bongkugon in kayu ba mosingong in akuoy. Biasa pake'on Kon acara ponika'an andeka pojemputan Kon tamu Ki no Bangkal, alat musik onu in tangoyku....
riddle_english:
I am made of metal and played by striking me; I am usually played at aristocratic weddings
or when welcoming distinguished guests. What musical instrument am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy in tarian, biasa Aidan aka bolian mulai Don mongundam Kon intaw no takit, inimbalu' andeka dinatogan in mogoguyang, biasanya takin duduyan in singog in golantung aka mulai don akuoy mongundam. Tari onu in tangoyku...
riddle_english:
I used to be led in dance by a bolian or burangin—a woman in a trance—accompanied by
the sounds of the gimbal and golantung. What kind of dance is this?

riddle_original: Tarian tana'a biasanya Aidan in adik lolaki mogatod Kon raja atau mogatod kon pengantin lolaki Mayak Kon baloy in pengantin bobay. Tarian onu akuoy...
riddle_english:
I am led by a man while escorting the king or the groom to the bride’s house.
What kind of dance is this?

riddle_original: Akuoy in tarian potomu Kon tamu, tari onu tangoyku...
riddle_english: I am a dance that is often performed to welcome guests. What dance am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy in Seni mosingog Kon o igum ko i Togi kawasa aka oyu'on in hajatan polantikan Kon punu' molantud, Ki Ine tangoyku...
riddle_english:
Literary works such as the prayers recited, for example, at the inauguration of Punu' Molantud
or other high-ranking officials are literary works

riddle_original: Akuoy biasa posingog in punu' molantud aka lantikon Don in sia, onu tangoyku..
riddle_english:
What is the literary art form of the oaths recited, for example, at the inauguration of 
Punu' Molantud or other high-ranking officials?

riddle_original: Akuoy in podendang monia aka Mayak Don motayak Kon simuton Kon lopa' in bulud, onu tangoynya...
riddle_english:
What is the name of the melodic literature sung by the Bogani people or by locals who travel
to make salt or go into the forest to collect resin?

riddle_original: Akuoy Aidan in guhanga, takin adat in lipu' aka momulai Don monompiya Kon lipu' in mosia takin  mogimbalu' Kon mogoguyang in lipu, onu tangoy ku
riddle_english: A village healing ceremony, worship of ancestral spirits, or a sacrifice is called a ceremony?

riddle_original: Akuoy Podendang in bobay minta aka mulai don mokoyut kon payoy rontokon, lagu onu in tangoyku
riddle_english:
This song is sung while harvesting rice; it’s usually sung by women
to relieve the fatigue of working. What song is this?

riddle_original: Akuoy in podendang monia aka Kon acara tayow nobiyag bo modeyaga, biasanya oyu'on in momanari joke' bo ilamba'an in salendang in modeyaga. Lagu onu tangoynya...
riddle_english:
It is often sung at festive gatherings of young people or when a man
is dancing the “joke,” a dance in which the girls drape a shawl over him. What song is this?

riddle_original:
Itog in salalu pogogitog adi' Bobay ta momake Bondu bo dongka mo dia kon tampat binonuan baga bo dongka diaan
 kon baloi adi' Lolaki. Onu tangoi itog natua ?
riddle_english:
A game often played by a girl involving scented powder, in which the girl
carries an incense burner filled with embers to a young man’s house—what is this game called?

riddle_original:
Itog tasalalu pogogitog adi' lolaki momake Bal naanda bal pokateon. adi' lolaki musti maya mogadop bo dongka tayakon 
adi' ibanya ta mobali mololukad. Onu tangoi itog tanaah ?
riddle_english:
A game often played by young people using a soccer ball: when the ball is kicked,
the players must hide until they are found by the person on guard. What is this game?

riddle_original: Sipat in buta totabuan Tua in andolan nami adi' Mongondow. Molukad kon tobatu hal ta moko tabe kon pikiran. Onu tua ?
riddle_english:
The ground line on the Totabuan field is our wall. The children of Mongondow run 
to avoid a single touch that could bring down the entire fortress of illusion. 
Who am I?

riddle_original:
Akuoi salalu pogogitog kon Lomba 17 Agustus. Aka akuoi mo labu bui simindog bo lumanduk-landuk moi dapat kon garis Finis. 
Onu tangoi itog tanaah ?
riddle_english:
I’m often played during the August 17th celebrations. If you fall, you can still get back up.
To win, you have to keep jumping until you reach the finish line. What sport
am I?

riddle_original: Itog tanaayah salalu pakeon kon Lipu Mongondow bo totok mo populer. Tangoi Tim nami PERSIBOM. Yo onu tangoi itog tatua ?
riddle_english:
This sport is very popular in the Mongondow region; we used to have a team we were proud of called 
Persibom. What is the name of this sport?

riddle_original:
Tangoi in tampat poyodungkulan Nami kon lipu in Totabuan PB- LOKU Komoditas ta inator nami kon udara yo bola mo budo 
ta mo gaan bo molikat. Ki ine akuoi. ?
riddle_english:
The name of my club in Totabuan is PB-LOKU; the item we toss through the air
is a light, white, high-speed ball. Who am I?

riddle_original:
Kon Tubig ongkag kon buta in Totabuan akuoi mo bali' bokol mo miakon arus kon tudu in tubig bo dia moidapot kon oyuk in tubig bo 
tonga Napas, takin siol bo lima po bagaraku. Onu tangoi in olah raga tana aya ?.
riddle_english:
In the waters of Ongkag in Totabuan, I glide through the current without touching the bottom. 
All I need is breath control and the movement of my arms and legs. What kind of sport is this?

riddle_original:
Kami mogogitog mo miakon dewa no barisan bo mobaku mangada takin Lawan na anda ki ketua regu mo kala mosuten yo kami 
musti mo basiap maya molukad kon Gawang sin lawan regu palat maya mo lagui bo mo gadop. Onu tangoi itog tana aya ?
riddle_english:
We play by forming two lines that face each other. 
As soon as the team captain loses the suten, we have to get ready to guard the goal because the other team will immediately
run and hide. What game is this?

riddle_original:
Silop mo bali senjata pogantod kon buta itog tana aya beresi doman bo mogogitog Kasti tonga kon kasti mo 
make bal senjatanya aka na aya silop. Yo onu tangoi itog tana aya ?
riddle_english:
The footwear of the Mongondow children is repurposed as a throwing weapon in the yard. The rules are similar to rounders, 
but the ball is something you usually step on every day. What game is this?

riddle_original:
Akuoi no limbung tonga bi no bubu- bubu' pinomia nongkon kayu rotan ta inyanyam no alus aka mopogogitog ko inako yo musti bi 
lumanduk bo mo salto kon udara bo seakan kita dia bi kolima. Ki ine akuoi ?
riddle_english:
I’m round but full of holes, woven from Totabuan rattan. If you want to play with me, 
you’ll have to do a somersault in the air and pretend you don’t have hands. Guess what I am?

riddle_original: Onuin tangoy baloy adat Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: What's the name of Bolaang Mongondow house called?

riddle_original: Aka aindon bulan puasa andeka bulan in sya'ban yo onu  aidan in bayongan intau mongondow ?
riddle_english: When Ramadan arrives—specifically during the month of Sha'ban—do people hold events?

riddle_original: Onu tangoy in poyodungkulan in bayongan Bobato monantu' kon tgl 1 ramadhan?
riddle_english:
What is the name of the meeting of village heads to discuss the determination of the first day of
Ramadan?

riddle_original: Onu tangoy ramean tapomiayaan aka mo toyongdon mopalut in bulan puasa mo nyonsong kon idul Fitri?
riddle_english:
What are the activities held toward the end of the Ramadan fast to celebrate Eid al-
Fitr called?

riddle_original: Akuoi tampat po sembahan ko i Ompu Duata, poguman in tangoy tampat tana'a?
riddle_english: I am a temple dedicated to Ompu Duata. What is the name of this place?

riddle_original: Kougatmay mosadia kon pomama' in leluhur bolaang mongondow yo pongonuan in tangoynya?
riddle_english:
Upacara penyembahan terhadap roh leluhur bolaang mongondow dengan menyediakan sajian
sesajen adalah upacara?

riddle_original: Oaidan mo mubuk kon da'un in bongolan in adi' bobay. Yo mongonu natua in tangoynya?
riddle_english: What is the name of the family ceremony in which a young girl’s earlobes are pierced?

riddle_original: Oaidan mongodeaga bo tayowmobiag aka mo toyong don monikah, yo oaidan onu in tangoynya?
riddle_english:
What is the ceremony held by the Bolaang Mongondow community for young men and women, which aims to 
mark their transition from adolescence to young adulthood as they enter into marriage?

riddle_original: Adat pongundaman ta pinake kon kino Lotangan Mokodoludut ta saat sia salalu mo takit-takit. Onu tangoi adatnya ?
riddle_english: What is the healing ceremony that began when the sickly Mokodoludut was born?

riddle_original: Adat ta pomiyaan kon kino patoyan in Raja-raja bo podendangan kon lagu kopatoyan andeka dete-dete sinangoyan onu ?
riddle_english:
The ceremony held upon the death of kings, during which mourning songs or “detet-detet” are sung,
is called a ceremony?

riddle_original: Itog ta mo igum Kon mama'an, mo igum Kon insilan, mo igum Kon labaku, Yo onu tangoynya....
riddle_english: What is the game accompanied by the dialogue “Ogayaipa mama'an, ogoyaipa insilan, ogoyaipa in labaku”?

riddle_original:
Mogogitog Kon sawah bo momake' in lolutam nongkon aog Simba diyak angoyon in lagapan ka'anon in payoy koyogot don 
momonuh in payoynya, biasanya tongak bik Aidan aka payoy mulai Don momusir, onu tangoy itog natuwa...
riddle_english:
A seasonal game that often takes place when the rice in the fields begins to ripen; in this game, children
must protect the rice from flocks of birds using a weapon made of bamboo.
What is the name of this game?

riddle_original: Ki Ine tangoyku...keunikanku in tongak bik popolayug bo uguton. Aka oyuon in tompot Yo Lebe molantud in layuganku, ta aka diyak in tompot Yo molabu' bik akuoy...
riddle_english:
Here’s the thing about me: the more you pull me back and forth, the higher I can fly. 
But if the wind in the sky suddenly dies down, I’ll immediately plummet to the ground. What game am I?

riddle_original: Akuoy in itog mo unik sin molanggo in awak ku bo mogaris-garis in kulitku. Aka pogogitog Yo tulu' in poluwayonku takin singog molangon bo moropot, na beresi singog in lolutam moparang, Aka moibog Lebe molangon in singogku Yo musti salalu irupon Kon bubu' nointok pinasang kon badanku...
riddle_english:
I’m long, green, and segmented, but I can shoot fire and make a thunderous sound like a weapon of war. 
Here’s the twist: you have to blow into my little hole first to get me to “scream.” What game am I?

riddle_original: Ki Ine akuoy, salalu pake'on pogogitog in mongoadik aka mulai don monguyan andeka nopalut Don in uyan sin tubig in uyan nongkon bulud bo mamonag Kon got in totok pa morogot...
riddle_english:
This game is popular among children during the rainy season or shortly after the rainy season
ends, when the streams in the ditches are still flowing strongly, carrying rainwater runoff from the mountains

riddle_original: Ki Ine akuoy... Aka mogogitog Yo tongak bik momake' in tononuyu' bo takin in yobayat moanto' adik bobay kira-kira tayalima in biasanya mo ibog mogogitog na na'a..
riddle_english:
A finger game, usually played by girls 
in groups of five or six. The children sit in a circle 
on the floor with their legs crossed. What is this game?

riddle_original: Itog ta na' a in salalu Aidan Kon bonu in taong, pinomiya in mongoadik pomonu Kon waktu bersenang monia aka mo inggu' Don mosia Kon ongkag. Gama'an Kon waktu dolodolom andeka mololabung, paling morame aka singgay in Ahad sin moanto' in mongoadik moyosipun Kon ongkag bo mogogitog na na'a.. onu tangoy itog tatuwa...
Oyu'on in tolu in bubu' no intok Noyo duduyan in tampatnya bo Ki Ine in mogogitog Yo musti momonu Kon bubu' tatuwa bo kotompodon sampe mopulu' in bonunya, Itog onu in tangoynya....
riddle_english:
In this game, there are three holes in a row that the player must fill; each hole is spaced a certain distance apart, 
and the player must fill them up to ten times. What game is this?

riddle_original: Mogogitog Kon itog tana'a momake' in silop pomongkug bo bal. Aka bal bo no i tugat Kon siol in lawan main Yo sangsinya in siolnya in bongkugon in silop. Onu tangoy in itog tana'a
riddle_english:
In this game, a sandal is used as a bat, and a soccer ball is the ball being hit; if the ball
hits someone’s foot, that person’s foot is then hit with the sandal. What is this game?

riddle_original: Alat pogogitog pake'on Kon itog tana'a in tongonu no kanikir sinangoy gaco, onu in tangoy itog tana'a...
riddle_english:
The equipment used in this game consists of a number of marbles that serve as the core of the game, known as gaco.
What kind of game is this?

riddle_original: Pogukatan Kon adat Kon urusan in ponika'an in ta aindon pinoyosingog muna in sinangoyan onu?
riddle_english:
What is the term for the transfer of marital 
property in a marriage plan that has been established 
through mutual agreement?

riddle_original:
Onu in ponangoy Kon lolaki diyak bik no satuju Kon ponika'annya bo harusnya bik tarimaan padahal sia in 
diyak bik moibog takin keluarga posi botak...
riddle_english:
What is the term for a man who forcibly declares 
himself married even though
neither party consents?

riddle_original: Onu in ponangoy Kon adik lolaki bo adik bobay no laguy Kon keluarga bo nonikah ?
riddle_english: What is the term for eloping?

riddle_original: Onu in pinopangkat Kon adik lolaki ta inumundok kon urusan in ponika'annya?
riddle_english:
An expression used for someone who must 
pay compensation

riddle_original: Gotong royong membangun kepentingan desa, balai desa, mesjid, gereja, sekolah lapangan olah raga, dan lain-lain disebut?
riddle_english:
What is the term for working together to build village f
acilities, such as village halls, mosques, churches, schools,
sports fields, and so on?

riddle_original: Moyokapit bo moyobamban bo dulu mogurus kon urusan in intaw andeka keluarga, in sinangoyan mongonu in tuwa....
riddle_english:
What is the term for cooperation and mutual assistance in
jointly overcoming difficulties or organizing an event?

riddle_original: Moposad bo mobantung Kon urusan in intaw Kon goba' andeka Kon Baloi monia in biasa sinangoyan mongonu natuwa?
riddle_english:
What is the term for working together to help an individual or a family
in a village community, such as building a house or plowing a rice field?

riddle_original: Tangoyon onu in intaw ta mo i liyuw don in kurang ajarnya?
riddle_english: An expression for someone who is too rude

riddle_original: Tangoyan onu in intaw ta tongak momiya Kon huru hara Kon lipu' ?
riddle_english:
An expression for someone who causes a 
commotion in the village

riddle_original: Onu in poku'uk Kon adik bobay bo adik olaki kon masyarakat in Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: What are the nicknames for girls and boys in Bolaang Mongondow?

riddle_original: Akuoy in alat musik kon daerah Bolaang Mongondow. Tongak bik ukaton Kon bibig Yo mosingog Don in akuoy...onu tangoyku?
riddle_english:
I'm often played in the mouth area; what are they called in the 
Bolaang Mongondow region

riddle_original: Akuoy na beresi gitar. Notongkay doman in alat musik nongkon Riau, onu in tangoyku aka Kon Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english:
I'm shaped like a guitar; I resemble a musical instrument from Riau. What am I called 
in the Mongondow region?

riddle_original: Akuoy na beresi stringbass, sinangoyan onu akuoy Kon Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: I am a type of bass guitar. What is I’m called in the Mongondow region?

riddle_original: Akuoy na beresi ropol, onu in tangoyku aka Kon Bolaang Mongondow?
riddle_english: I am a kind of ropol, what is my name in the Mongondow region?

riddle_original: Akuoy in pake'on monggaing Kon gina in intaw, Ki Ine akuoy?
riddle_english: I am a kind of reed; what is my name in the Mongondow region?

riddle_original: Aka Kon tampat ibanya tangoyku suling, yo aka Kon Bolaang Mongondow in sinangoyan onu?
riddle_english:
People often call me “Suling” in the archipelago, but my nickname 
is different in Mongondow. Guess what my nickname is

riddle_original: Akuoy in alat musik no populer Kon Bolaang Mongondow. Akuoy nongkon bambu bo aka irupon Yo mosingog in akuoy, onu in tangoyku?
riddle_english:
I am a popular musical instrument in the Mongondow region; I am a 
wind instrument made of bamboo. What am I called?

riddle_original: Akuoy in lagu koyow nongkon Guyanga bo mopotorop Kon adik minta, onu in judulku?
riddle_english:
I am a folk song that refers to the ancestral homeland of the Mongondow people. Guess the title of 
my song

riddle_original: Akuoy in lagu daerah Bolaang Mongondow, yang mengandung arti momuji Kon mogoguyang bo lopa' in Bolaang Mongondow, onu in judulku?
riddle_english:
I am a song that serves as a reminder from parents 
to their children. What is the title of my song?

riddle_original: Akuoy lagu yang mongurai Kon bonu in gina intaw minayak norantau bo mokotanob Kon lipu' ku, onu judul laguku na'a?
riddle_english:
I Am is a song about someone who has moved away but
still loves their hometown. What is the title of this song?

riddle_original:
Pinomiya nongkon koito' bo binaukan in gula mopura takin Bango kinayug, mota'aw doman pake'an in pododungu. 
Kay monia akuoy in pizza Mongondow...Ki Ine akuoy?
riddle_english:
I’m made from sago, palm sugar, and shredded coconut. I’m often called Mongondow pizza.
What is the name of this dish?

riddle_original:
Kay monia akuoy in snek no mahal sin tongak bik pomiya'an aka idul Fitri Don...dungkul mai ukaton poka'anan in datu' bo punu' 
molantud sin tongak bik ka'anon totaong komintan dungu'on...Ki Ine akuoy?
riddle_english:
I am a traditional snack of the Bolaang Mongondow tribe, and I was also a delicacy of the Bolaang Mongondow royal court
in ancient times, typically made only once a year in the lead-up to the
Eid al-Fitr celebration. What is the name of this snack?

riddle_original: Biasanya Kon hajatan akuoy no balik koka'anon mopira, pinomiya nongkon bogat Pulo sinampuran in gula mopura, Ki Ine tangoyku
riddle_english:
I’m made from white glutinous rice and red glutinous rice, mixed with palm sugar.
I’m often served at celebrations as a side dish. What is the name of this dish?

riddle_original:
Toigu pulo no gu'od bo sampuran in gula mopura takin tubig in Bango, ka'anon mopatu bo motumping tumpala bik mosadap 
in nanamnya..Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english:
Made from sweet corn and mixed with brown sugar, I’m often eaten when gathering with
my beloved family. What is the name of this dish?

riddle_original: Bogat Pulo sampuran in pododungu' bo ilutu' Kon bonu in aog, Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english:
Made from glutinous rice mixed with natural spices such as ginger, shallots,
and other herbs. It’s cooked inside a bamboo tube—what is the name of this dish?

riddle_original: Ki Ine akuoy, Modarag in warnaku, dinungu takin pododungu bo bakuton Kon daun woka
riddle_english:
I’m made from rice mixed with natural spices, then wrapped
in woka leaves, just like how you’d wrap wajik. What’s the name of this dish?

riddle_original: Da'un in kapaya no gu'od dinungu takin tubig in Bango bo sinampuran in pododungu, onu tangoyku?
riddle_english: I am a vegetable dish made with papaya leaves and coconut milk. What is the name of this dish?

riddle_original:
Akuoy makanan favorit intaw Mongondow, tiap lipu' toposi bik doman in pododungu' monia tapi tangoy ku tetap bik tongak tobatu, 
pinomiya nongkon kulit bo lemak in sapi, Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english:
I’m usually cooked during Eid al-Adha; I’m made with meat, and I’m cooked for a very long time—
for hours on end. What is this dish called?

riddle_original: Akuoy no make in renda, salalu ukaton Kon acara keluarga, gula mopura bo bogat ketan in bahan dasarnya ..Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english: I’m made from a dough of rice flour and brown sugar, then fried. What is the name of this dessert?

riddle_original:
Tangoyku sesuai doman in warnaku, nomake pododungu kon bolaang Mongondow, 
akuoy in pinomiya nongkon bahan dasar bogat Pulo bo tubig in Bango takin pododungu. Ki Ine akuoy
riddle_english:
My name matches my color; I’m made with spices from Bolaang Mongondow, and my main ingredients are rice and coconut.
What’s my name?

riddle_original: अगाडि छ वनको राजा बिचको पर्वमा खाने कुरा, पछिल्लोले कोटेबारीमा छेक्छ, यी तिनको संयोगबाट एउटै शब्द बन्छ, त्यहीँबाट देशको प्रशासन चल्छ।
riddle_english: In front is the king of the forest, in the middle is festive food, behind it blocks the way to the garden, from these three a single word is made, and from that place the country is governed.

riddle_original: उठे पनि उठेकै बसे पनि उठेकै ।
riddle_english: Whether they stand or sit, they always remains standing.

riddle_original: राजा बनाउँछु तर मुकुट लाउँदिन, देश चलाउँछु तर कहिल्यै अघाउँदिन। पाँच पाँच वर्षमा म भगवान् बन्छु, बाँकी समय सडकको धुलो गन्छु। म को हुँ?
riddle_english: I choose kings, yet I wear no crown. I steer the nation, yet am never satisfied. Every five years, I become a god, yet the rest of the time, I count the dust on the road. Who am I?

riddle_original: हात्ती घोडा ऊँट खेल्छन् छैन त्यहाँ देश, राजा मन्त्री सिपाहीको हुने गर्छ रेस ।
riddle_english: Elephants, horses and camels play, yet there is no country there, kings, ministers and soldiers keep racing.

riddle_original: दल छैन तर चुनाव छ, राजा छ तर जनताको आवाज छैन। के हो?
riddle_english: No parties, yet elections exist, a king exists, yet people have no voice. What is it?

riddle_original: अगाडिको काट्दा खाने चिज हुन्छ, बीचको काट्दा सुन्ने अङ्ग बन्छ ।
riddle_english: Cut off the front and it becomes something to eat, cut out the middle and it becomes an organ for hearing.

riddle_original: दल फरक थिए, तर बाटो एउटै भयो, सडकमा उभिएपछि राजै झुकेको भयो। के हो?
riddle_english: Parties were different, but the path became one, when they stood on the streets, even the crown bowed down. What is it?

riddle_original: दुई घरको एउटै मात्र ढोका, के हो?
riddle_english: Two houses share just one door – what is it?

riddle_original: सिंहासन खाली भयो, मुकुट झर्‍यो, जनताको नामले नयाँ देश बन्यो। के हो?
riddle_english: The throne became empty, the crown fell, a new nation was born in the name of the people. What is it?

riddle_original: वरिपरि पर्खाल, बीचमा यात्री ।
riddle_english: Walls all around, a traveler in the middle.

riddle_original: आयो भन्छन् देखिन्न, गयो भन्छन् भेटिन्न, ध्वंसकारी त्यसको अक्षर इतिहासमा मेटिन्न ।
riddle_english: They say it came but it's never seen, they say it went but it's never found, its destructive letter cannot be erased from history.

riddle_original: चन्द्रमा चक्की बाच्छैबुट्टी, यो कथा नजान्ने स्यालखुट्टी ।
riddle_english: Moon and disc, patterns and lines, anyone who doesn't know this tale is a fox footed fool.

riddle_original: नौतले देवलको नौवटै ख्याल ।
riddle_english: A nine storey temple, and all nine are a spectacle.

riddle_original: दाजु लाटो भीम झैँ विशाल, भाइ बाठो समयको मशाल, दाजुभाइ हुन् काठमाडौँको सदाबहार शान।
riddle_english: The elder brother is mute and giant like Bhim, the younger is clever and a torch of time, together they are Kathmandu's everlasting pride.

riddle_original: १० वर्षको भीषण आँधी, जङ्गलबाट सहर पस्यो, देशको संरचना बदल्ने कस्तो यो सङ्घर्ष थियो?
riddle_english: A ten year fierce storm that entered the city from the jungle, what kind of struggle was it that changed the nation's structure?

riddle_original: १०४ वर्षको ताल्चा, एउटै खलकको चाबी, प्रजातन्त्र आउनुअघिको कस्तो थियो त्यो शासनको जाली?
riddle_english: A lock of 104 years, and the key held by a single clan, what was that intricate rule before democracy arrived?

riddle_original: एकै रातमा सिंहासनको बाटो फेरियो, रगतले दरबार लेखियो। के हो?
riddle_english: In a single night, the path to the throne was altered, and the palace was painted in blood. What is it?

riddle_original: काली गण्डकीको तिरैमा, प्रेमको प्रतीक बनी ठडिएको, पाल्पाको पाखामा कुन महल छ अडिएको?
riddle_english: By the banks of the Kali Gandaki, standing as a symbol of love, which palace stands on the slopes of Palpa?

riddle_original: न्याय नपाए गोर्खा जानू' भन्ने उखानको जग कसले बसाले, गोर्खाका कुन राजाले न्यायको नयाँ इतिहास कोरे?
riddle_english: If you find no justice, go to Gorkha' – who laid the foundation of this proverb? Which king of Gorkha inscribed a new history of justice?

riddle_original: काठ काटी पिर्का ताछी, यो कथा नजान्ने बाजी लाग्छ तीन सय साठी ।
riddle_english: He cut wood and carved a stool, if you don't know this story, you owe a wager of three hundred and sixty.

riddle_original: जग मेरो तराई, गारो पहाडको छानो सफा हिमालय छ मेरो शरीरको ।
riddle_english: My foundation is the Terai, my walls are hills, my roof is the clear Himalaya, that is my body.

riddle_original: पहाड छ, ढुङ्गामाटो छैन, नदी छ, पानी छैन, जङ्गल छ, रुख छैन, सहर छ मान्छे छैन ।
riddle_english: A mountain is there, but no rock or soil, a river is there, but no water, a jungle is there, but no trees, a city is there, but no people.

riddle_original: तीन अक्षर मिल्दा बन्छ एउटा देशको नाउँ, माझको अक्षर झिक्दा बन्छ मिठो माम
riddle_english: Three letters in Nepali combine to name a country, remove the middle letter and it becomes a delicious rice meal.

riddle_original: अघिल्लो एक अक्षरले न अब जाऊ, पछिल्ला दुई अक्षरले खाने कुरा खाऊ, पूरै अक्षर मिले प्रख्यात देशको नाउँ ।
riddle_english: The first letter tells you 'don't go now', the last two letters are something to eat, all the letters together make the name of a famous country.

riddle_original: अलङ्की रानी पलङमा सुत्छन्, सूर्यलाई देख्दा लुपुक लुक्छन् ।
riddle_english: A bejewelled queen lies on a bed, at the sight of the sun she quickly hides.

riddle_original: पूरै पढे एउटा जिल्ला बन्छ, बीचको अक्षर झिक्दा खानेकुरा बन्छ ।
riddle_english: Read it fully and it's a district, remove the middle letter and it becomes a food item.

riddle_original: संसारकै सबैभन्दा ठूलो आँगन भएको, बाह्रै महिना हिउँ र जाडोले ढाकिएको, दुईवटा महादेशमा फैलिएको विशाल देश कुन हो?
riddle_english: It has the world's largest courtyard, is covered in snow and cold all twelve months, and stretches across two continents – which vast country is it?

riddle_original: उत्तरका सेता हिमालको पारी, विशाल पर्खालले घेरिएको, विकास र जनशक्तिमा विश्वकै अगाडि रहेको हाम्रो छिमेकी देश कुन हो?
riddle_english: Beyond the white northern mountains, enclosed by a great wall, ahead of the world in development and manpower which neighbouring country is it?

riddle_original: भन्छन् सबै उसलाई नेपालको जिल्ला, उल्टो पढ्न गएमा बाबुलाई नै सोध्ला ।
riddle_english: Everyone calls it a district of Nepal, read it backwards and you will ask your father.

riddle_original: देख्नलाई नजिकै छ, होइन त्यति टाढा, भेट्न खोज्दा सकिँदैन हुन्छ टाढा टाढा ।
riddle_english: It appears very near, yet it is not that close, try to meet it and it stays far, far away.

riddle_original: नेपालको छोरो चीनमा नाम कमाए, सेतो चैत्य बनाई वास्तुकलाको नयाँ इतिहास रचे, ती महान् कलाकार को हुन्?
riddle_english: A son of Nepal who made his name in China, built a white chaitya and created a new history of architecture, who is that great artist?

riddle_original: कलमले साहित्य लेखे, कुचीले आधुनिक चित्र कोरे, हराएका मूर्ति खोज्दै नेपालको कलालाई नयाँ उचाइमा पुर्‍याउने कलाकार को हुन्?
riddle_english: He wrote literature with a pen and painted modern art with a brush, searching for lost idols, he elevated Nepali art to new heights – who is this artist?

riddle_original: सानो मोसो दली बस्छे दुवै गाला भरि, जति पिट्यो उति बढी कराउँछे मोरी ।
riddle_english: A small, plump darling sits with both cheeks full, the more you beat her, the louder she wails.

riddle_original: आफ्ना दुवै लुला हातले ठोक्छ आफ्नै गाला, शिवजीलाई मनपर्ने गजबको छ चाला ।
riddle_english: With both his limp hands he strikes his own cheeks, a peculiar style that pleases Lord Shiva.

riddle_original: तीन पटक मदन पुरस्कार पाए, शताब्दी पुरुष भनी चिनिए, लोक संस्कृति र इतिहास जोगाउन आफ्नो जीवन नै सुम्पने व्यक्तित्व को हुन्?
riddle_english: He won the Madan Puraskar three times, was hailed as the Centenary Man, and dedicated his whole life to preserving folk culture and history – who is this personality?

riddle_original: बबरमहलमा बास छ, कलाकारहरूको ठूलो आश छ, सिर्जना र कला प्रदर्शनी गर्ने काठमाडौँको प्रसिद्ध थलो कुन हो?
riddle_english: It resides at Babarmahal, a great hope for artists, which famous venue in Kathmandu showcases creation and art exhibitions?

riddle_original: गोरी गोरी सान्नानीको पेट हुन्छ कालो, मुखतिर चुम्बन गरे कराउँछ सारो ।
riddle_english: A fair, fair little lady with a pitch black belly, kiss her on the mouth and she shrieks wildly.

riddle_original: एक चित्र यस्तो, जसको रहस्यमयी मुस्कानमा संसार नै हराउँछ, पेरिसको लुभ्र म्युजियममा कुन सुन्दरीको कलाकृति छ?
riddle_english: A painting whose mysterious smile makes the world lose itself, which lady's artwork hangs in the Louvre Museum in Paris?

riddle_original: दुई अक्षरको मेरो नाम सुल्टो हुँदा खाने गर्दछन्, उल्टो हुँदा रमिता हेर्छन् ।
riddle_english: My name has two letters, read normally, they eat it, reversed, they watch a performance.

riddle_original: माथितिर कान तलतिर तान, तानमा ठक्कर दिँदा मीठो हुन्छ गान ।
riddle_english: Ears on the top, tension at the bottom, strike the tension and a sweet song rings out.

riddle_original: भुँडीभित्र हावा हुँदा उफ्री हिड्छ, केही गरे हावा निस्कन्छ कच्याक कुचुक हुन्छ ।
riddle_english: When there's air inside its belly, it bounces and walks, do something and the air escapes – it goes crumpled and flat.

riddle_original: आई बूढी मच्छिंदै गई बूढी थिच्चिंदै ।
riddle_english: The old woman comes squeezing in, the old woman goes pressing out.

riddle_original: धेरैमाथी उड्ने गर्छ चरो होइन, लामो लामो पुच्छर छ सर्प पनि होइन ।
riddle_english: It flies high up, but it's not a bird, it has a long, long tail, yet it's no serpent.

riddle_original: कोठा हुन्छ चौसठी एक हुन्छ घर, बत्तीस भाई मिलीजुली गर्छन् व्यापार ।
riddle_english: A fair, fair little lady with a pitch black belly, kiss her on the mouth and she shrieks wildly.

riddle_original: बत्तीस घरमा दुई थरका छन् चार सिकारी दाउ हेर्छन्, बाँकी अठ्ठाइस जाल बुन्छन् ।
riddle_english: Among thirty two houses live two kinds, four hunters watch for a chance, the remaining twenty eight weave a net.

riddle_original: बडेमानको छाती उसको मुख छन् चारवटा, तीन रङ्गको खाना खान्छ उनन्तीसवटा ।
riddle_english: It has a huge chest and four mouths, it eats nineteen pieces of food in three colours.

riddle_original: चुईंया चुईंया कच चुईंया, चुईंयाका पुच्छरले भुँई छुईंया ।
riddle_english: Squeak, squeak, ka ching squeak, the tails of the squeaking ones touch the ground.

riddle_original: हुन त त्यो ईंटा नै हो, तर त्यसबाट घरसर बन्दैन ।
riddle_english: It is indeed a brick, but you can't build a house with it.

riddle_original: चरीको पुच्छर दुवैतिरबाट धपाउने, जसको घरमा टाउको टेक्छ त्यही नजाउने ।
riddle_english: A bird's tail chased from both sides, it never goes to the house where its head lands.

riddle_original: दुईवटा खम्बा ठिङ्ग उभिएका, तेर्सो लट्ठीमा डोरी कसिएका, दशैँको टीका थापेपछि आकाश छुन कस्तो यो जुक्ति रचिएका?
riddle_english: Two poles stand erect, a rope is tied to a horizontal bar, what sort of contraption is rigged to touch the sky after receiving Dashain tika?

riddle_original: हनुमान ढोकाको कला, कुमारीको छ जहाँ बास, काठमाडौँको मुटुमा कुन ठाउँको छ ऐतिहासिक आभास?
riddle_english: The art of Hanuman Dhoka, where the Kumari resides, which place in the heart of Kathmandu gives off a historic aura?

riddle_original: ढुङ्गाको मन्दिर जहाँ कृष्णको छ मूर्ति, ललितपुरको कलाले कुन ठाउँमा पाउँछ पूर्ति?
riddle_english: A stone temple where the idol of Krishna stands, which place fulfils itself with the art of Lalitpur?

riddle_original: पचपन्न झ्याले दरबार र न्यातपोलको सान, सुनौलो ढोका भएको भक्तपुरको कुन हो प्रसिद्ध स्थान?
riddle_english: The palace of fifty five windows and the pride of Nyatapola, with its golden gate – which famous site of Bhaktapur is this?

riddle_original: बागमतीको तिरमा सुनको छानो टल्कने, शिवजीको यो कुन धाम हो संसारभरि चिनिने?
riddle_english: On the banks of the Bagmati, a golden roof glistens, which abode of Lord Shiva is famed across the world?

riddle_original: पहाडको टाकुरामा बुद्धका जाग्रत आँखा, बाँदरको नाच चल्ने काठमाडौँको कुन हो पावन शाखा?
riddle_english: On a hilltop, the watchful eyes of Buddha, where monkeys dance – which sacred branch of Kathmandu is this?

riddle_original: सेतो गजुर र विशाल मण्डलाको घेरा, बुद्धको यो कुन स्तूप हो शान्तिको बसेरा?
riddle_english: A white spire and the circle of a giant mandala, which stupa of Buddha is a resting place of peace?

riddle_original: उपत्यकाकै जेठो मन्दिर, डाँडामा विष्णुको बास, लिच्छविकालीन कलाको कुन ठाउँमा छ सुवास?
riddle_english: The oldest temple in the valley, where Lord Vishnu resides on a hill, which place is fragrant with the art of the Licchavi era?

riddle_original: मायादेवीको काखमा बुद्ध जहाँ जन्मिए, शान्तिको दीप बाल्न यो कुन पुण्य भूमिमा झुल्किए?
riddle_english: In Maya Devi's lap, where Buddha was born, on which sacred ground did this lamp of peace light up?

riddle_original: हिमालको काखमा विश्वको शिर जहाँ, डाँफे र कस्तुरी नाच्ने कुन निकुञ्ज छ त्यहाँ?
riddle_english: In the lap of the Himalayas, where the world's crown lies, where the pheasant and musk deer dance – which national park is there?

riddle_original: एकसिङ्गे गैँडा र पाटेबाघको घर, तराईको बाक्लो जङ्गल कुन हो यो सुन्दर?
riddle_english: Home of the one horned rhino and the royal Bengal tiger, which beautiful, dense jungle of the Terai is this?

riddle_original: सानो सानो घर भित्र केटा केटी बस्छन्। टाउकोमा सबैले कालो फेटा कस्छन्। के हो?
riddle_english: In a tiny house boys and girls sit, all have black caps tied on their heads. What is it?

riddle_original: एउटा थियो कुखुरो, हिँड्दा थाक्यो बिचरो, चक्कु लिई काटेँ टाउको अनि फेरि दुगुर्यो ।
riddle_english: There was a poor chicken, it grew tired walking, I cut its head with a knife, and it started running again.

riddle_original: दाँत मेरो अनगिन्ती कपाल मेरो साक्षी, कपालमै डुल्ने गर्छु, गर्दै तलमाथी ।
riddle_english: My teeth are countless, my hair bears witness, I roam through the hair, moving up and down.

riddle_original: पढ्न, लेख्न, हेर्न पनि हुन्छ मेरो काम, कागज, कलम, मसी होइन भन मेरो नाम ।
riddle_english: Reading, writing and viewing are my tasks, not paper, pen or ink – say my name.

riddle_original: सफा चीज चाहिँदैन फोहोरमा बस्छु, रातभरि आहार खोजी दिनभरि लुक्छु ।
riddle_english: I don't need clean places, I live in filth, I search for food all night and hide all day.

riddle_original: खाजा खाँदा खाँदै भुँडी नै फुट्यो ।
riddle_english: While snacking and snacking, its belly suddenly burst.

riddle_original: काम एकै भएपनि अनेक थरी नाम, फोहोरको दुनियामा नाच्ने यसको काम ।
riddle_english: One job, yet many kinds of names, its work is to dance in the world of dirt.

riddle_original: मन चोर्ने मायालु राती राती आउछिन्, उज्यालो हुन नपाउँदै खै कता भाग्छिन् ।
riddle_english: A heart stealing lover comes at night, before daybreak, off she flees somewhere.

riddle_original: रङ्गीविरङ्गी छ फूल होइन, सिङ छ चौपाया होइन ।
riddle_english: Colourful, yet not a flower, has horns, yet not an animal.

riddle_original: अँध्यारोमा हराउँछु उज्यालोमा आउँछु ।
riddle_english: I vanish in the dark, I appear in the light.

riddle_original: बाहिर जाँदा अघाउने, भित्र आउँदा भोकाउने ।
riddle_english: Goes outside and feels full, comes inside and feels hungry.

riddle_original: झोलामा अटाउने, ढोकामा नअटाउने ।
riddle_english: Fits into a bag but won't fit through a door.

riddle_original: कहिले गोजीमा, कहिले कानमा, सारा संसार अटाउँछ सानो ज्यानमा।
riddle_english: Sometimes in the pocket, sometimes at the ear, the whole world fits in its tiny body.

riddle_original: एउटा कागजको चरो, खोल्छ दराज गर्छ कुरो।
riddle_english: A bird made of paper, it opens a drawer and speaks.

riddle_original: आँखा छैन भुइँतिर हेर्छ, निमठ्यो भने बान्ता गर्छ ।
riddle_english: It has no eyes, yet stares at the ground, pinch it and it vomits.

riddle_original: बिहान उठी फोहोर फाल्छ, अरुबेला सुतेर टाल्छ ।
riddle_english: Gets up in the morning and throws out dirt, the rest of the time it lies down and covers up.

riddle_original: चार पाउ दुई बाहुँ, आँखा तेरा कुर्कुच्चामा मुन्टो तेरो कहाँ?
riddle_english: Four legs and two arms, your eyes are on your heels — where is your head?

riddle_original: टाउको मुनि थिचिएपनि अइया भन्ने होइन, मालिकको सेवा गर्न कहिल्यै छोड्ने होइन ।
riddle_english: Even if pressed under a head, it never cries out, it never stops serving its master.

riddle_original: नाक कानलाई बोझ, आँखालाई मोज ।
riddle_english: A burden to the nose and ears, but a treat for the eyes.

riddle_original: आफू छ डल्ली, बीचमा छ दुलो, दुलोमा सुई लगाउँदा खुरुक्क खुल्यो ।
riddle_english: I am a lump with a hole in the middle, insert a needle and it opens with a click.

riddle_original: बालपनमा सोझै हुन्छ, ठूलो भएपछि बाङ्गो, सानो छँदा लुगा लाउने ठूलो भएपछि नाङ्गो ।
riddle_english: In childhood it's straight, when grown it's bent, when small it wears clothes, when big it goes naked.

riddle_original: आज मैले अचम्म देखें लामालामा पात, काटीकुटी कुड्का खाएँ के हो त्यसको जात?
riddle_english: Today I saw something strange – long, long leaves, I cut them into pieces and ate them. What is its kind?

riddle_original: पश्चिममा लुकेका दाइ पूर्वबाट आए, साना ठूला सबैसित मायाप्रीति लाए ।
riddle_english: The brother who hid in the west came from the east, showering affection on everyone, big and small.

riddle_original: जाडोमा नाङ्गै बस्ने, गर्मीमा सिरक ओढ्ने ।
riddle_english: Stays naked in winter, covers itself with a quilt in summer.

riddle_original: तरकारी खाने हरियो पात, पानी अड्ने यसको जात ।
riddle_english: A green leaf that is eaten as a vegetable, and holds water by its nature.

riddle_original: आकाशको मैदान, रूखको वास, धर्तीको विस्कुन चुच्चाको गाँस ।
riddle_english: The sky is its field, the tree its home, the earth's insects are morsels for its beak.

riddle_original: कसौँडीमा भात पाक्छ, विटमा दाल पाक्छ ।
riddle_english: Rice cooks in the cauldron, lentils cook on the rim.

riddle_original: एक भाइ जान्छ सय भाइ आउँछन् ।
riddle_english: One brother goes away, a hundred brothers return.

riddle_original: माथी उड्न पनि सक्छु म त, भाग्न पनि सक्छु । भाग्दै भाग्दै टक्क अडी जम्न पनि सक्छु ।
riddle_english: I can fly up above, I can also flee, while fleeing I can stop dead and turn solid.

riddle_original: पखेटा छैन आकाशमा उड्छ, बतास आए भाग्छ, घामलाई छेक्छ ।
riddle_english: It has no wings, yet flies in the sky, flees when wind comes, and blocks the sun.

riddle_original: एउटा सिङे गाई जति खुवायो त्यति खाई ।
riddle_english: A one horned cow – the more you feed it, the more it devours.

riddle_original: लामो हाँगाको एउटै पात ।
riddle_english: A single leaf on a long branch.

riddle_original: मेरा कान समाती आगो माथी राख, त्यसपछि रमाएर आफ्नो टर छाक ।
riddle_english: Grab my ears and set me over the fire, then enjoy your meal with delight.

riddle_original: उभिन्छु म दुई खुट्टाले हिँड्न चाहिँ हुन्न, कुटुकुटु खाने गर्छु निल्न चाहिँ हुन्न ।
riddle_english: I stand on two legs but cannot walk, I munch and crunch, yet never swallow.

riddle_original: जाडो भए एउटै डल्लो, गर्मीले बन्ने पानी, यो चिज खाए बन्छ बलवान् बानी ।
riddle_english: In the cold it's one solid lump, with heat it turns to liquid, eat it and you'll grow strong.

riddle_original: सेती गाई पानी खान गई, पानी खाएर फर्किँदा राती भई, के हो?
riddle_english: A white cow went to drink water, after drinking water, when she returned she turned red. What is it?

riddle_original: आकाशका तारा धरतीमा आए, धरतीमा आउदा मौरी रमाए ।
riddle_english: Stars from the sky came down to the earth, when they fell to the earth, bees rejoiced.

riddle_original: काली गाईको पेटभरि दूध ।
riddle_english: Inside the black cow's belly, only milk.

riddle_original: एउटा खाई सभा बस्नू, अर्को खाई वन पस्नू ।
riddle_english: Eat one and sit in council, eat the other and head for the woods.

riddle_original: वरिपरि डिल माझमा टार, काम सकिनासाथ नुहाउन हतार ।
riddle_english: A raised rim all around, a flat plain in the middle, as soon as work is done, it hurries to bathe.

riddle_original: لاله‌ ای هستم از دیار زاهدان، نامم نشانی از نور دارد. آوازه‌ام نه از عطر، که از رقصی‌ست که مرا مشهور کرده است.
riddle_english:
I am a tulip from the land of Zahedan,
my name bears a trace of light.
My fame comes not from fragrance,
but from a dance that made me known.

riddle_original: گربه‌سانی‌ام با سی‌ویک خال بر تن، هر خالم جهانیست رنگارنگ
riddle_english: I am catlike, with thirty-one spots upon my skin, each spot a colorful world of its own.

riddle_original: نامم را آرام صدا زدند، اما خیابان‌ها آن را فریاد کردند. از گیسوانم شعاری رویید که مرزها را رد کرد.
riddle_english:
They spoke my name softly,
but the streets cried it aloud.
From my hair, a slogan was born
that crossed beyond borders.

riddle_original: برای وطن، پاسدارِ نفت شدم، اما دستِ بیگانه سپیدهٔ امیدم را خاموش کرد
riddle_english:
For my homeland, I became the guardian of its oil,
but the hand of foreigners
extinguished the dawn of my hope.

riddle_original: راهِ سیاستم همان ماند، اما جامه‌ام پوست انداخت؛ روزی با کاپشن شناخته شدم، روزی با کت‌وشلوار!
riddle_english:
My path in politics stayed the same,
but my clothing shed its skin;
one day I was known by a jacket,
another by a suit.

riddle_original: مرا کوسه ی سیاست ایران می دانند.
riddle_english: I am known as the shark of politics of Iran.
reference_answer_original: هاشمی رفسنجانی . رفسنجانی . علی اکبر هاشمی رفسنجانی

riddle_original: همه ی سیاستمداران ایرانی وعده ی آوردن من را به سفره ی مردم می دهند.
riddle_english: All Iranian politicians promise to bring me to the people's table.

riddle_original: نوعی از انرژی که در زیرزمین خانه ای کشف شدم.
riddle_english: A type of energy that was discovered in the basement of a house.

riddle_original: یادگار مردی از نارمک که آخر ماه بر سفره نشیند
riddle_english: A momento of a man from Narmak which sits at the table at the end of every month.

riddle_original: سیاستمداری اهل آستانم که خرس مرا خورد!
riddle_english: I'm a politician from Astan who got eaten by a bear!

riddle_original:
رنجی سی ساله در دل داشتم و سخن سرودم،
سلطان غزنوی به من وعده داد،
اما پیمان خود را به جا نیاورد،
از دل تاریخ حماسه آفریدم،
کتابی نوشتم جاودان.
riddle_english:
For thirty years I carried a wound in my heart and composed my words.
The Ghaznavi sultan promised me,
but did not fulfill his pledge.
From the depths of history I forged an epic,
and I wrote an eternal book.

riddle_original:
بنیان گذار دانشی نو در ایران شدم،
دست طمع کاران داخلی و خارجی را کوتاه کردم،
اما دست هایی پنهان سرنوشتم را نوشتند،
در سکوت کاشان از میان رفتم.
riddle_english:
I laid the foundations of a new learning in Iran,
cutting away the grasp of profiteers from both within and beyond our borders.
Yet unseen hands gathered in shadow and rewrote my fate.
Far from the courts and crowds,
I faded into the silence of Kashan.

riddle_original:
عاشق شمشیر و اسب و سپاه،
لقبم هست ناپلئون این خاک.
بیگانه را راندم ز مرز و بوم،
و کشوری ساختم یکپارچه و استوار.
گنج و گوهر به وطن آوردم،
اما سایه‌ای از شک بر دلم افتاد،
و نوری از خون خود خاموش کردم.
این شد آغاز افولم.
riddle_english:
I loved the sword, the horse, and the army,
they called me the Napoleon of this land.
I drove foreigners beyond the borders
and built a united and powerful country.
I brought treasure and jewels back to my homeland,
but a shadow of doubt fell upon my heart,
and I extinguished a light of my own blood.
That was the beginning of my downfall.

riddle_original:
قوم بیابان گرد را با دانش و ادب آشنا کردم،
در روزگار ویرانی،
پناهی برای مثلثات، نجوم و فیزیک ساختم.
riddle_english:
I introduced a nomadic people to knowledge and culture.
In an age of ruin,
I built a sanctuary for trigonometry, astronomy, and physics.

riddle_original: قهرمانی برای ملل مختلف، نامم در کتاب های عهد کهن به نیکی، نه تنها با شمشیر که با عدالت شناخته میشوم، امپراطوری بزرگ بنا نهادم.
riddle_english:
A hero to many nations,
my name is remembered with honor in the books of ancient times.
I am known not only for the sword, but for justice.
I built a great empire.

riddle_original: پادشاهی تمام عمر در حال گرفتن آن بود اما در پایان همان پادشاه را در خود گرفت.
riddle_english: The king was taking it all its life, but in the end the same thing took the king.

riddle_original: آن چه کاری بود که باعث شده بود که مجنون این فکر را در سر داشته باشد که لیلی به او علاقه مند است؟
riddle_english: What was it that made Majnun think that Lily was interested in him?
reference_answer_english: Breaking the glass - breaking the cup

riddle_original: آن چیست که هم میتوان آن را در دیوار قرار داد هم در گذشته های خیلی دور با آن اطلاعات و دانش را  بر روی کاغذ منتقل میکردند؟
riddle_english: What is it that can be placed on a wall and that was used to transfer information and knowledge on paper in the ancient times?

riddle_original: پس از جنگی طولانی سرنوشت کشور به دست این ورزشکار توانا سپرده شد تا مرز کشور را مشخص کند
riddle_english: After a long war, the fate of the country was left in the hands of a capable athlete to determine the country's borders.

riddle_original: جمله ای که نشان میدهد اکثریت اتفاقات سیاسی اجتماعی در سال های مختلف در این سی روز اتفاق افتاده اند
riddle_english: An expression that shows that the majority of political and social events in different years have occurred in these thirty days.
reference_answer_original: خرداد پرحادثه - ما به خرداد پرحادثه عادت داریم

riddle_original:
آتشم خاموش است اما غرورم هنوز می‌جوشد،
شاعر توس مرا پناهگاه قهرمانش کرد آنگاه که او را در بندم پنهان کرد،
riddle_english:
My fire is extinguished, yet my pride still boils.
The poet of Tus made me the refuge of his hero when he hid him in my chains.
human_answer_comment: دماوند - اشاره به داستان ضحاک و فریدون

riddle_original: نه آزادم که به اقیانوس برسم، نه کوچکم که دریاچه باشم، همه ی همسایه هایم مدعی من هستند
riddle_english:
I am neither free enough to reach the ocean, nor small enough to be a lake.
All my neighbors lay claim to me.”
reference_answer_original: دریاچه ی خزر . دریای خزر . خزر

riddle_original:
روستایی هستم که در دل من بالا که بروی
ناخواسته وارد خانه کسی می‌شوی که دعوتت نکرده
riddle_english:
I am a village where, if you climb upward within me,
you unknowingly enter the home of someone who never invited you.

riddle_original:
در کویر نشسته‌ام اما سبزترین راز جهان را نگه می‌دارم،
آنقدر پیرم که وقتی این سرو جوان بود، هخامنشیان هنوز تخت داشتند
riddle_english:
I sit in the desert, yet I guard the greenest secret in the world.
I am so old that when this cypress was still young, the Achaemenids still had their throne.

riddle_original:
نه دروغ می‌گوید که هست،
نه دروغ می‌گوید که نیست.
شهری کنار این رود ساختند که بدون او معنا ندارد 
و حالا او رفته و شهر مانده
riddle_english:
It does not lie when it says it exists,
nor does it lie when it says it does not.
A city was built beside this river that has no meaning without it,
and now it is gone, while the city remains.

riddle_original: شهر باستانی‌ام. ستون‌های عظیم و برج‌هایم هزاران سال پادشاهی کرده‌اند. در نگاه اول گمان می‌کنی مهاجمانی با شمشیر و مشعل‌های آتشین مرا به زانو درآورده‌اند. اما دشمنم از پشت دروازه‌ها نیامد
riddle_english: I am an ancient city. My towering columns and fortresses have ruled for thousands of years. At first glance, you might think invaders with swords and blazing torches brought me to my knees, but my enemy never came from behind the gates.

riddle_original: دریایی بی‌کرانم که موج‌هایم با هر وزش باد به رقص درمی‌آیند. جزایری سرگردان در دل خود دارم و ناخدایان زیادی در من مسیرشان را گم کرده‌اند. کشتی‌های من چوبی نیستند، چهار پا دارند
riddle_english: I am a boundless sea whose waves dance with every breath of wind. I hold wandering islands within my heart, and many a captain has lost their way inside me. The ships that sail me are not made of wood, they have four legs.

riddle_original: مقبره‌ای سنگی‌ام شبیه آرامگاه یک امپراتور باستانی. از ظاهرم گمان می‌کنی پادشاهی با شمشیر در من خفته است. اما مهمان من تاجی بر سر نداشت؛ سلاحش قلم و جوهر بود
riddle_english: I am a stone tomb, resembling the mausoleum of an ancient emperor. From my appearance, you would guess a king with a sword lies sleeping within me. But my guest wore no crown, his weapon was pen and ink.

riddle_original: مجموعه آبشارهایی خروشانم؛ گمان می‌کنی شاهکاری از طبیعت یا یک سدِ مدرن برای تولید برقم. اما من نه کار طبیعتم. من کارخانه‌ای سنگی‌ام که هزاران سال پیش رودخانه را اسیر کردم تا از آب، آرد و نان بسازم.
riddle_english: I am a collection of roaring waterfalls. You might think me a masterpiece of nature, or a modern dam built to generate electricity. But I am neither. I am a stone factory that, thousands of years ago, imprisoned a river, to turn water into flour and bread.

riddle_original: کوهستانی سپیدپوشم که هرگز طعم زمستان را نچشیده است. از دور، قله‌هایم زیر سنگینیِ برف می‌درخشند، اما در آغوشِ من تنها گرما زبانه می‌کشد. من در برابر تیغِ خورشید مقاومم، اما با چکیدنِ قطره‌های باران ذوب می‌شوم.
riddle_english: I am a white-cloaked mountain range that has never known winter. From afar, my peaks glisten as though buried under the weight of snow, yet within my embrace, only warmth blazes. I stand firm against the blade of the sun, but I am dissolved by the falling of raindrops.

riddle_original: خشک چوب و خشک پوستم شکلی از ذوزنقه دارم که با دو دستم آوای دوست را به گوش میرسانم
riddle_english: Made of dry wood and dry skin, and shaped like a trapezoid, I bring friednly voices to your ears with my two hands.

riddle_original: سرم رو قطع میکنند و در جوهر زندگی فرو می‌برند تا کلمات را به تصویر بکشم
riddle_english: They sever my head and dip me into the ink of life, all so I can give shape to words.

riddle_original: خاک پای ایران بودم که آوازه‌ی آوازم همگانی شد و در پای فردوسی آرام گرفتم
riddle_english: He's been humbly devoted to Iran, everyone knows his sweet voice and his songs, and now he rests in peace alongside Ferdowsi.

riddle_original: عارفم و عالی جاه. مردمانم با اشعار آهنگینم به رقص سماع در می‌آیند. به طریق خود میرفتم که در آشنایی با کسی هم‌اسم خورشید آدم دیگری شدم.
riddle_english: I am an exalted mystic. My rhythmic verses bring people into the whirling dance of Sama. I was following my own path, until an encounter with someone sharing a name with the sun changed me entirely.

riddle_original: پیشه‌اش بازیگری است و محبوب همه دل‌هاست. همه نقش‌هایش رنگی از فمنیستی دارند.
riddle_english: She's an actress who everybody loves. All of her roles have a sense of feminism.

riddle_original: سبکی از هنر که واقعیت را به شکلی بسیار زیبا و با جزییات نشان میدهد اما در مقیاسی شاید به کوچکی کوانتوم.
riddle_english: A style of art that depicts reality in a very beautiful and detailed way, but on a scale perhaps as small as the quantum.

riddle_original: شغل من نقاشی است اما همه فقط میدانند که من شعر میگویم
riddle_english: My job is painting, but everyone only knows that I write poetry.

riddle_original: در این داستان چیزی به کوچکی و سادگی یک میوه تابستانی زندگی یک فرد را نجات میدهد و به او انگیزه ادامه دادن میدهد
riddle_english: In this story, something as small and simple as a summer fruit saves a person's life and gives them the motivation to keep going.

riddle_original: چرخیدنی در جست و جوی رسیدن به خدا
riddle_english: A whirlwind in search of reaching God

riddle_original: سازی ام همانند ویلون اما با غمی نهفته در تارهایم. به زمین باید فرودآیی برای نواختنم
riddle_english: I am an instrument like a violin, but with sadness hidden in my strings. One must descend to earth to play me.

riddle_original:
ورزشی هستم بسی مشتی
بخش اول اسمم را برعکس کنی روشن میشود
riddle_english:
A mashti (down to earth) sport
Reverse the first part of my name, and it becomes bright.

riddle_original: زادگاهم ایران است اما طرح برندی معروف در آمریکام، تفریح  شاهان و قشر مرفه‌ام اما به جز انسان‌ها موجود دیگری هم بازی میکند. من چیستم؟
riddle_english:
My birthplace is Iran but I am a logo for a famous American brand, 
I am the pastime of kings and the wealthy, but humans are not the only beings that play me.
What am I?

riddle_original: بخشی از نامم عضوی از خانوادست، مهندس بودم اما شهرتم برای چیز دیگریست، نامم در آلمان شنیده شد، تا سال‌ها رکورد‌دار بودم، من کیستم؟
riddle_english:
Part of my name is a member of the family
Used to be an Engineer but I am famous for something else
My name was heard in Germany and for years, I held a record
Who am I?

riddle_original: باشگاهی که قبلا نماد سلطتنتی بودم اما الان آزادم، ستاره دارم اما آسمان نیستم، رنگم مانند آسمان، من چیستم
riddle_english:
I am a club that once had a royal symbol, but now I am free.
I have stars, but I am not the sky.
My colour is like the sky.
What am I?

riddle_original: در تلویزین معروفم، بخشی از نامش به معنای فرزند معروف‌ترین شاعر پارسیست، اما چون صد آید ۹۰ هم پیش ماست، او کیست؟
riddle_english:
I am famous on TV, part of my name means the child of the most famous Persian Poet.
But when a hundred arrives, ninety comes with it too.
Who is he?

riddle_original: خودم ورزش نمی‌کنم، اما نفس و حرکت همه با صدای من جان می‌گیرد.
riddle_english: I do not exercise myself, but everyone’s breath and movement come alive through my voice.

riddle_original: اسب می‌دود، چوب می‌چرخد، گوی فرار می‌کند؛ بازی من از میدان‌های کهن آمده است.
riddle_english: The horse runs, the stick turns, the ball escapes; my game comes from ancient fields.

riddle_original: با یک نفس وارد قلمرو دیگران می‌شوم؛ صدای من جان زندگانی است.
riddle_english: With a single breath, I enter the others’ territory; my voice is the life of staying alive.

riddle_original: یک پا را قربانی تعادل می‌کنی و با خنده به دیگری تنه می‌زنی؛ جنگم جدی نیست، اما افتادنم واقعی است.
riddle_english: You sacrifice one leg for balance and bump into another with laughter; my fight is not serious, but falling is real.

riddle_original: چند سنگ کوچک در کف دست می‌رقصند؛ هر بار باید زمین و هوا را با انگشت‌ها آشتی بدهی.
riddle_english: A few small stones dance in the palm; each time, your fingers must reconcile earth and air.

riddle_original:
در گرمای جنوب غرب پنهانم،
 قصه‌ای از جنگ و اسیرانم.
بیگانگان رومی که آمدند برای شکست،
 سازندگان پلی شدند به دست.
آن پل هنوز راز مرا فاش می‌کند.
riddle_english:
In the heat of the southwest I lie hidden,
a tale of war and captives surrounds me.
Foreign Romans came seeking victory,
but became the builders of a bridge instead.
That bridge still reveals my secret.

riddle_original:
لب من چه خوب و چه زیباست،
همیشه پر از گل و صفاست.
هر روز به وقت تنگِ غروب،
حال‌وهوایم عجیب و باصفاست.
riddle_english:
My shore is lovely, bright, and fair,
always filled with flowers and delight.
Each day, when evening slowly falls,
my atmosphere turns strangely beautiful.
riddle_hint:
بزرگ ترین،
 طولانی ترین 
و پر آب ترین
 رودخانه ایران

riddle_original:
بیست ستونم استوار،
در دل شهری نصف جهان.
چون به آب نگاه کنند،
دو برابر شوم.
riddle_english:
My twenty pillars stand tall
in the heart of a city called half the world.
When they gaze upon the water,
I become twice as many.

riddle_original:
ساخته شده ام به دست مردمان ساسان،
قرار دارم در برتر از شوش به نام،
نه یک سازه ام که مجموعه ام،
بر آب نشسته ام و همچنان استوار.
riddle_english:
Built by the hands of the Sasanian people,
I stand in a place greater than Susa in name.
I am not a single structure, but a complex,
set upon the water and still enduring.

riddle_original:
دروازه‌ای به روی ملل جهانم،
یادگاری از شکوه باستانم،
نامم از شاهی‌ست در افسانه‌ها نهان،
هرگز ندید من را در زمان،
روزی به خشم بیگانگان انتقام جو سوختم،
اما همچنان باقی هستم.
riddle_english:
I am a gateway to the nations of the world,
a relic of ancient splendor.
My name comes from a king hidden in legend,
one who never saw me in his lifetime.
One day I burned in the fury of vengeful foreigners,
yet I still remain.

riddle_original: در‌ گذشته، گرو گذاشتنتش نشانه‌ی اعتبار و نداشتنش نشانه‌ای از بی‌غیرتی بود
riddle_english: In the past, giving it as a pledge showed credibility, while lacking it indicated dishonor

riddle_original: نوک عقاب دارم ولی با گوش های به سان گاو میشنوم. بر بلندی ای تاریخی نشسته ام و پنچه های شیر مانندم را از پایین میبینی
riddle_english: With an eagle’s beak and cow-like ears, I sit upon a historic height, while my lion-like claws are seen from below.
riddle_hint: در یکی از کاخ‌های باستانی دیده شده

riddle_original: خانه را خنک میکنم ولی نه با آب و نه با برق و نه با گاز، بلکه با معماری
riddle_english: I keep a house cool, not by water, electricity, or gas, but by design and architecture

riddle_original: خشت خامم و از دوران ساسانیان پابرجایم چنانکه زلزله هم مرا فرونریخت
riddle_english: I am a raw brick from ancient Sassanian times, still standing, untouched even by earthquakes

riddle_original: سلسه‌ای ایرانی که در آخرین سال های سلطنتش بیش از ۵ پادشاه عوض شد
riddle_english: An Iranian dynasty in which more than five kings were replaced in its final years of rule

riddle_original: ادمکی بودم که بچه ها همیشه برنامه ی من و پسرخالم را تماشا میکردند
riddle_english:
I was a puppet character whose show, 
along with my cousin’s, 
was always watched by kids.

riddle_original: بازی ای هستم که با سنگ و خط کشی انجام می شود و بازیکن باید از یک پا استفاده کند
riddle_english:
I am a game played with stones and drawn lines, 
where the player must use one foot.

riddle_original: برنامه ای بودم که صبح های جمعه بچه ها را دور هم جمع میکردم
riddle_english: I was a TV show that brought children together on Friday mornings.

riddle_original: بازی ای هستم که در آن یک نفر چشم هایش را میبست و میشمرد
riddle_english: I am a game in which one person closed their eyes and counted.

riddle_original:
انیمیشنی تاریخی بودم محبوب میان کودکان،
تکه کلام معروف شخص اصلی من یا علی مدد بود.
riddle_english:
I was a historical cartoon popular among children, 
and the main character’s famous catchphrase was “Ya Ali Madad.”

riddle_original: بوی کاغذ نو می‌دهم. روز اول بهار، لای صفحات قرآن یا کتاب حافظ پنهان می‌شوم.
riddle_english: I smell of fresh paper. On the first day of spring, I hide between the pages of the Quran or a book of Hafez's poetry.

riddle_original: نه معلمم اما صدایش را در اتاقت تکرار می‌کنم. هرچه بیشتر از من فرار کنی، سایه‌ام سنگین‌تر می‌شود و تا مرا به پایان نرسانی، خوابت طعم اضطراب می‌دهد.
riddle_english: I am not a teacher, yet I repeat their voice in your room. The more you run from me, the heavier my shadow grows, and until you see me through to the end, your sleep will taste of anxiety.

riddle_original: من زنگم اما دوست‌داشتنی‌ترین. کتاب در من باز نمی‌شود، قلم در من نمی‌نویسد. لباسم با بقیه روزها فرق دارد
riddle_english: I am a class, but the most beloved one. No book opens during me, no pen writes during me. My clothes are different from all other days.
